Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne ke baad khansi aati hai aur gala ghutne lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A choking cough that occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को गला घुटने जैसी खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko gala ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A choking cough that occurs at night around midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के आसपास गला घुटने जैसी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke aaspas gala ghutne jaisi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A choking cough that occurs during sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद में खांसी आती है और गला घुटने लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Nind mein khansi aati hai aur gala ghutne lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, choking, sleep, as soon as one falls into a sound
Linked to time of day.en: A choking cough that comes on as soon as one falls into a deep sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: जैसे ही गहरी नींद आती है, गला घुटने जैसी खांसी शुरू हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Jaise hi gehri nind aati hai, gala ghutne jaisi khansi shuru ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A choking cough triggered by breathing in.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: सांस अंदर लेने पर गला घुटता है और खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sans andar lene par gala ghutta hai aur khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, choking, sensation as if, fauces from to bifurcation of bronchia
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough with a sensation of choking that seems to run from the back of the throat all the way down to where the airways divide in the chest.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे गले की जड़ से लेकर सांस की नली के नीचे तक कुछ फंसा हो और दम घुटे।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise gale ki jad se lekar sans ki nali ke neeche tak kuch fansa ho aur dam ghute.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, choking, sleep, when lying on side
Linked to posture/position.en: A choking cough that occurs when lying on one's side during sleep.
Linked to posture/position.hi: करवट लेकर सोते समय गला घुटने जैसी खांसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Karvat lekar sote samay gala ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Getting cold brings on the cough.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंड में जाने से खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi mein jane se khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: The cough starts when you become chilled.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंड लगने पर खांसी शुरू हो जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi lagne par khansi shuru ho jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, cold, becoming, on, arm or hand
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Getting your arm or hand cold brings on the cough.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: हाथ या बाँह ठंडी पड़ने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Hath ya banh thandi padne par khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Getting your feet cold brings on the cough.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: पैर ठंडे पड़ने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Pair thande padne par khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, cold, becoming, on, single part
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Getting any single part of the body cold brings on the cough.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: शरीर के किसी एक हिस्से के ठंडे पड़ने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Sharir ke kisi ek hisse ke thande padne par khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, cold, going from warm, to
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Going from a warm place into the cold triggers the cough.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म जगह से ठंडी जगह में जाने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garam jagah se thandi jagah mein jane par khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Cold wind blowing on the chest triggers the cough.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: छाती पर ठंडी हवा लगने से खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Chaati par thandi hava lagne se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Cold drinks trigger the cough.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: ठंडा पानी या ठंडे पेय पीने से खांसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Thanda pani ya thande peya peene se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Cold drinks make the cough worse.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: ठंडा पानी या ठंडे पेय पीने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Thanda pani ya thande peya peene se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Cold drinks ease or relieve the cough.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: ठंडा पानी पीने से खांसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Thanda pani peene se khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Cold milk triggers the cough.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: ठंडा दूध पीने से खांसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Thanda doodh peene se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Eating cold food triggers the cough.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: ठंडा खाना खाने से खांसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Thanda khana khane se khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific situations.path: Cough, cold, standing, cold water, in
Triggered by specific situations.en: Standing in cold water triggers the cough.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: ठंडे पानी में खड़े रहने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Thande pani mein khade rehne par khansi hoti hai.

General.en: The cough continues without stopping both day and night.
General.hi: दिन और रात दोनों समय लगातार खांसी बनी रहती है।
General.roman: Din aur raat donon samay lagataar khansi bani rahti hai.

General.en: The cough is constant, occurring either during the day or at night.
General.hi: दिन में या रात में खांसी लगातार रहती है।
General.roman: Din mein ya raat mein khansi lagataar rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is constant throughout the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को खांसी लगातार बनी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko khansi lagataar bani rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is constant in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय खांसी लगातार रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay khansi lagataar rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is constant throughout the night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खांसी लगातार बनी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko khansi lagataar bani rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, constant, night, sleep, on falling to
Linked to time of day.en: The cough starts constantly as soon as you fall asleep at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को नींद आते ही खांसी शुरू हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko nind aate hi khansi shuru ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The constant cough wakes you up at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को नींद से जागने पर खांसी लगातार रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko nind se jagne par khansi lagataar rahti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, constant, lying agg., sitting up amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: Lying down makes the constant cough worse, but sitting up makes it better.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है और बैठने से आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne se khansi badh jati hai aur baitne se aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: Lying down eases the constant cough.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने पर खांसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne par khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The constant cough is worse when lying down at night.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को लेटने पर खांसी लगातार रहती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko letne par khansi lagataar rahti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: Vomiting relieves the constant cough.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: उल्टी (वमन) होने पर खांसी में आराम मिलता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Ulti hone par khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, constriction, chest
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The cough comes with a feeling of tightness or squeezing in the chest.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: छाती में कसाव होकर खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Chati mein kasav hokar khansi ati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, constriction, larynx
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The cough comes with a tight, constricted feeling in the throat (voice box area).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के ऊपरी हिस्से (स्वर यंत्र) में कसाव होकर खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ke uparli hisse mein kasav hokar khansi ati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, constriction, trachea, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A tight, constricted feeling in the windpipe triggers the cough.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: श्वास नली में कसाव होने से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Shwas nali mein kasav hone se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Eating causes a tight, constricted feeling that brings on the cough.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते समय गले या छाती में कसाव होकर खांसी आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khate samay gale ya chati mein kasav hokar khansi ati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, constriction, in first sleep, while lying on the side
Linked to posture/position.en: During the first part of sleep, a squeezing or tightening sensation while lying on your side triggers the cough.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पहली नींद में करवट लेकर लेटे हों तो गले में कसाव होकर खांसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Pehli nind mein karwat lekar lete ho to gale mein kasav hokar khansi ati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tight, constricting sensation during sleep at night triggers the cough.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को नींद के दौरान गले या छाती में कसाव होकर खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko nind ke dauran gale ya chati mein kasav hokar khansi ati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, constriction, sleep, on going to
Linked to time of day.en: A tightening or squeezing sensation as you are falling asleep triggers the cough.
Linked to time of day.hi: सोने जाते समय गले में कसाव होकर खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sone jate samay gale mein kasav hokar khansi ati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, crawling, sensation of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The cough is triggered by a crawling feeling somewhere in the airways.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: रेंगने (सुरसुरी) जैसा महसूस होकर खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: rengne (sursuri) jaisa mehsus hokar khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, crawling, sensation of, air passages, in
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A crawling sensation in the air passages triggers the cough.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: सांस की नलियों में रेंगने जैसी सुरसुरी महसूस होकर खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: sans ki naliyom mein rengne jaisi sursuri mehsus hokar khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, crawling, sensation of, bronchia
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A crawling sensation in the bronchial tubes (deep airways) triggers the cough.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: सांस की छोटी नलियों (ब्रोंकाई) में रेंगने जैसी सुरसुरी से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: sans ki chhoti naliyom (bronkai) mein rengne jaisi sursuri se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, crawling, sensation of, chest
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A crawling sensation in the chest triggers the cough.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: छाती में रेंगने (सुरसुरी) जैसा लगने से खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: chhati mein rengne (sursuri) jaisa lagne se khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, crawling, sensation of, larynx
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A crawling sensation in the throat (voice box area) triggers the cough.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के ऊपरी हिस्से (स्वर यंत्र) में रेंगने जैसी सुरसुरी से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: gale ke uparI hisse (svar yantr) mein rengne jaisi sursuri se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, crawling, sensation of, throat-pit
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A crawling sensation in the throat-pit (the hollow at the base of the throat) triggers the cough.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के गड्ढे (कंठ के नीचे) में रेंगने जैसी सुरसुरी से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: gale ke gadhe (kanth ke neeche) mein rengne jaisi sursuri se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, crawling, sensation of, trachea, in
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A crawling sensation in the windpipe triggers the cough.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: श्वास नली में रेंगने जैसी सुरसुरी महसूस होकर खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: shwas nali mein rengne jaisi sursuri mehsus hokar khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, crawling, sensation of, evening, bed, in
Linked to time of day.en: A crawling sensation in the evening while lying in bed triggers the cough.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बिस्तर में लेटते समय रेंगने जैसी सुरसुरी महसूस होकर खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: sham ko bistar mein lete samay rengne jaisi sursuri mehsus hokar khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A crawling sensation at night triggers the cough.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को सांस की नली में रेंगने जैसी सुरसुरी से खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: rat ko sans ki nali mein rengne jaisi sursuri se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, crawling, sensation of, night, midnight, before
Linked to time of day.en: A crawling sensation before midnight triggers the cough.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात से पहले रेंगने जैसी सुरसुरी से खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: rat ko aadhi rat se pehle rengne jaisi sursuri se khansi hoti hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The cough makes a croaking sound during the daytime.
Sounds & movement.hi: दिन के समय खांसी की आवाज़ मेंढक जैसी टर्र-टर्र होती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: din ke samay khansi ki aawaz medhak jaisi tarr-tarr hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A harsh, croup-like cough comes on after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद कुत्ते जैसी भौंकने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: khana khane ke baad kutte jaisi bhounkne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A harsh, croup-like cough comes on in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय भौंकने जैसी कर्कश खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: sham ke samay bhounkne jaisi karkash khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A harsh, croup-like cough comes on in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय भौंकने जैसी कर्कश खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay bhaunkne jaisi karkash khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A harsh, croup-like cough comes on at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को भौंकने जैसी कर्कश खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko bhaunkne jaisi karkash khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, croupy, night, midnight, after, agg.
Linked to time of day.en: A harsh, croup-like cough is worst after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद भौंकने जैसी कर्कश खाँसी और बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ke baad bhaunkne jaisi karkash khansi aur badh jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A harsh, croup-like cough only happens after waking up.
Linked to time of day.hi: भौंकने जैसी कर्कश खाँसी केवल नींद से जागने के बाद ही आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Bhaunkne jaisi karkash khansi keval nind se jagne ke baad hi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A harsh, croup-like cough occurs when breathing out.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: साँस बाहर छोड़ते समय भौंकने जैसी कर्कश खाँसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: sans bahar chhodte samay bhounkne jaisi karkash khansi aati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, croupy, winter, alternating with sciatica in summer
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A harsh, croup-like cough in winter that alternates with sciatic nerve pain (pain shooting down the leg) in summer.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: सर्दियों में भौंकने जैसी कर्कश खाँसी आती है और गर्मियों में यह साइटिका (पैर-कमर के दर्द) में बदल जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Sardiyon mein bhaunkne jaisi karkash khansi aati hai aur garmiyon mein yah saitica (pair-kamar ke dard) mein badal jati hai.

General.path: Cough, croupy, with sopor, stertorous breathing and wheezing, with open mouth and head thrown back; the child starts up, kicks about, is on point of suffocating, turns black and blue in face, after which cough with rattling breathing sets in again, suffocates
General.en: A severe croup-like cough with noisy, rattling breathing and wheezing, the mouth is open and the head is thrown back; the child suddenly wakes up, kicks, and seems to be on the verge of suffocation, turning bluish in the face, after which a cough with rattling breathing starts again.
General.hi: बच्चे को भौंकने जैसी कर्कश खाँसी के साथ गहरी ऊँघ, घरघराहट और सीटी जैसी साँस आती है; मुँह खुला रहता है और सिर पीछे की तरफ झुक जाता है; बच्चा अचानक उठता है, हाथ-पैर मारता है, दम घुटने की नौबत आती है, चेहरा नीला पड़ जाता है, फिर से घरघराहट वाली खाँसी शुरू हो जाती है और दम घुटता रहता है।
General.roman: Bachche ko bhaunkne jaisi karkash khansi ke saath gehri oongh, gharghrahat aur siti jaisi sans aati hai; munh khula rehta hai aur sir pichhe ki taraf jhuk jata hai; bachcha achanak uthta hai, hath-pair marta hai, dam ghutne ki naubat aati hai, chehra nila pad jata hai, phir se gharghrahat wali khansi shuru ho jati hai aur dam ghutta rehta hai.

Type of pain.en: A sharp, cutting pain in the thyroid gland (at the front of the neck) triggers the cough.
Type of pain.hi: गले की थायरॉइड ग्रंथि में काटने जैसा दर्द होता है और उससे खाँसी आती है।
Type of pain.roman: Gale ki thyroid granti mein katne jaisa dard hota hai aur usse khansi aati hai.

Type of pain.path: Cough, cutting, stinging, in larynx, from
Type of pain.en: A sharp, cutting, stinging sensation in the throat (voice box area) triggers the cough.
Type of pain.hi: गले में काटने और चुभने जैसे दर्द से खाँसी आती है।
Type of pain.roman: Gale mein katne aur chubhne jaise dard se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs only during the daytime, between 6 in the morning and 6 in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह छह बजे से शाम छह बजे के बीच खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah chhah baje se shaam chhah baje ke beech khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is worse during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय खाँसी और बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay khansi aur badh jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is better during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय खाँसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, daytime, day, every other, violent coughs
Linked to time of day.en: Every other day there are violent coughing fits during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: एक दिन छोड़कर दूसरे दिन बहुत तेज खाँसी के दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Ek din chhodkar dusre din bahut tej khansi ke daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs every third day.
Linked to time of day.hi: हर तीसरे दिन खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Har tisre din khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, daytime, expectoration copious, greenish, salty, agg. morning
Linked to time of day.en: During the day there is a lot of coughing up of thick greenish, salty mucus, which is worst in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन में खाँसी के साथ बहुत अधिक हरा-नमकीन बलगम निकलता है जो सुबह और बढ़ जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din mein khansi ke saath bahut adhik hara-namkin balgam niklta hai jo subah aur badh jata hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, daytime, hour, at the same
Linked to time of day.en: The cough comes at the same time every day.
Linked to time of day.hi: हर दिन एक ही निश्चित समय पर खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: har din ek hi nishchit samay par khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, daytime, morning on rising, continuing until lying down again
Linked to time of day.en: The cough starts in the morning on getting up and continues until you lie down again.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने पर खाँसी शुरू होती है और फिर से लेटने तक बनी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah uthne par khansi shuru hoti hai aur phir se letne tak bani rehti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs both during the day and at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन और रात दोनों समय खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: din aur raat donon samay khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs both during the day and at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन और रात दोनों समय खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: din aur raat donon samay khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, daytime, night, and, expectoration, with
Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs both day and night and produces mucus or phlegm.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन और रात खाँसी आती है और साथ में बलगम भी निकलता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: din aur raat khansi aati hai aur saath mein balgam bhi nikalta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs only during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: खाँसी केवल दिन में ही आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: khansi keval din mein hi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, daytime, only, long, lasting spells, dry, short, violent, with much dyspnea
Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs only during the day, in long-lasting spells that are dry, short, and violent, with a lot of breathlessness.
Linked to time of day.hi: केवल दिन में लंबे-लंबे दौरों में सूखी, तेज, छोटी-छोटी खाँसी आती है और साँस बहुत फूलती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: keval din mein lambe-lambe daure mein sukhi, tez, chhoti-chhoti khansi aati hai aur sans bahut phulti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs only during the day, or only at certain times.
Linked to time of day.hi: खाँसी केवल दिन में या किसी और समय आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: khansi keval din mein ya kisi aur samay aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, daytime, only, or cough which wakens at night
Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs only during the day, or it is the type that wakes you up at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: खाँसी केवल दिन में आती है या रात में नींद खुलने पर आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: khansi keval din mein aati hai ya raat mein nind khulne par aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, daytime, only, or, morning after rising, and evening after lying down
Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs only during the day, or only in the morning after getting up and in the evening after lying down.
Linked to time of day.hi: खाँसी केवल दिन में या सुबह उठने के बाद और शाम को लेटने के बाद आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: khansi keval din mein ya subah uthne ke baad aur shaam ko letne ke baad aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, daytime, only, or, only at night
Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs only during the day, or only at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: खाँसी केवल दिन में या केवल रात में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: khansi keval din mein ya keval raat mein aati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: The cough occurs during the day before the menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी से पहले दिन में खाँसी आती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahvari se pehle din mein khansi aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Cough, daytime, night, and, which makes boy quite breathless
Comes with other symptoms.en: The cough occurs both day and night and leaves a boy completely breathless.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: दिन-रात खाँसी आती है जिससे बच्चे का साँस पूरी तरह फूल जाता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: din-raat khansi aati hai jisse bacche ka sans puri tarah phul jata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A deep cough that occurs in the afternoon and evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर और शाम को गहरी भारी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: dopahar aur shaam ko gahri bhari khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A deep cough that occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को गहरी भारी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: shaam ko gahri bhari khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A deep cough that comes on after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद गहरी भारी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ke baad gahari bhari khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A deep cough that occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय गहरी भारी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay gahari bhari khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A deep cough related to breathing in.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: साँस अंदर लेने पर गहरी खाँसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: sans andar lene par gahri khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Taking a deep breath in relieves the deep cough.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: गहरी साँस अंदर लेने से खाँसी कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: gahri sans andar lene se khansi kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Breathing in deeply triggers the deep cough.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: साँस अंदर लेते समय गहरी भारी खाँसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Saans andar lete samay gahari bhari khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: Lying down eases the deep cough.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने पर गहरी खाँसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne par gahari khansi kam ho jati hai.

Sounds & movement.en: A deep-sounding cough that occurs at night.
Sounds & movement.hi: रात को खाँसी की आवाज़ बहुत गहरी और भारी होती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Raat ko khansi ki awaz bahut gahari aur bhari hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The cough comes on after eating dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: दोपहर का खाना खाने के बाद खाँसी आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Dopahar ka khana khane ke baad khansi aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The cough comes on after dinner when you fall asleep.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: दोपहर का खाना खाने के बाद जब नींद आती है तब खाँसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Dopahar ka khana khane ke baad jab nind aati hai tab khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The cough comes on before eating dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: दोपहर का खाना खाने से पहले खाँसी आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Dopahar ka khana khane se pehle khansi aati hai.

General.en: The cough is so distressing it goes on all day and night.
General.hi: दिन-रात खाँसी इतनी तेज होती है कि मन बेचैन और परेशान रहता है।
General.roman: Din-raat khansi itni tej hoti hai ki man bechai aur pareshaan rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A distressing cough that occurs during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन में खाँसी बहुत तकलीफदेह होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din mein khansi bahut taklifde hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, distressing, morning and evening, on going to sleep
Linked to time of day.en: A distressing cough that happens in the morning and evening, when first falling asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह और शाम को सोने जाते समय खाँसी बहुत तकलीफदेह होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah aur sham ko sone jate samay khansi bahut taklifde hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough that comes on after drinking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पीने के बाद खाँसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Pine ke baad khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough that gets worse after drinking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पीने के बाद खाँसी और बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Pine ke baad khansi aur badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough that gets better after drinking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पीने के बाद खाँसी कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Pine ke baad khansi kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough that comes on after drinking hurriedly.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: जल्दी-जल्दी पीने के बाद खाँसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Jaldi-jaldi pine ke baad khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs in the afternoon around 1 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद एक बजे सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad ek baje sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs in the afternoon around 3 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद तीन बजे सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad teen baje sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs in the afternoon around 4 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद चार बजे सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad char baje sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs in the afternoon around 5 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद पाँच बजे सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad paanch baje sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough with a runny or stuffy nose that is worse in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को जुकाम के साथ सूखी खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko jukam ke saath sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs during the daytime only.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, dry, daytime, loose at night
Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough during the day that becomes loose and productive at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन में सूखी खाँसी रहती है लेकिन रात को खाँसी में बलगम आने लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din mein sukhi khansi rahti hai lekin rat ko khansi mein balgam aane lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs both during the day and at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन और रात दोनों समय सूखी खाँसी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din aur raat dono samay sukhi khansi rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs in the evening around 6 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को ठीक ६ बजे सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko theek 6 baje sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs in the evening around 7 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को ७ बजे सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 7 baje sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough in the evening that gets worse when breathing in.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को साँस अंदर लेने पर सूखी खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko saans andar lene par sukhi khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, dry, evening, loose in morning
Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough in the evening that becomes loose and productive in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को सूखी खाँसी रहती है लेकिन सुबह बलगम आने लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko sukhi khansi rahti hai lekin subah balgam aane lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough in the evening that continues until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम से आधी रात तक सूखी खाँसी आती रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam se aadhi raat tak sukhi khansi aati rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, dry, evening, night, and can neither sleep nor lie down
Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough in the evening and at night so bad that you can neither sleep nor lie down.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम और रात को सूखी खाँसी इतनी होती है कि न नींद आती है और न लेट पाते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam aur raat ko sukhi khansi itni hoti hai ki na nind aati hai aur na let pate hain.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, dry, evening, sleep, on going to
Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough in the evening that starts when falling asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को सोने जाते समय सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko sone jate samay sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, dry, expectoration, morning, only in
Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough where any coughing up of phlegm only happens in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सूखी खाँसी है, बलगम केवल सुबह के समय निकलता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sukhi khansi hai, balgam keval subah ke samay nikalta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs in the late morning (before noon).
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के पूर्वार्ध (सुबह से दोपहर) में सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke purvardhh (subah se dopahar) mein sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs in the late morning around 11 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह ११ बजे सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah gyarah baje sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, dry, inhalation, on, sleep, in
Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough triggered by breathing in during sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद में साँस अंदर लेने पर सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Nind mein saans andar lene par sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah ke samay sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs early in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बहुत जल्दी सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah bahut jaldi sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, dry, morning, loose in afternoon
Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough in the morning that becomes loose in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह सूखी खाँसी रहती है और दोपहर बाद बलगम आने लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah sukhi khansi rehti hai aur dopahar baad balgam aane lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, dry, morning, loose in, evening
Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough in the morning that becomes loose in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह सूखी खाँसी रहती है और शाम को बलगम आने लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah sukhi khansi rehti hai aur shaam ko balgam aane lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough in the morning that comes on after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने के बाद सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah uthne ke baad sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough in the morning that comes on when waking up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलते ही सूखी खाँसी शुरू हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah nind khulte hi sukhi khansi shuru ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough that occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात के समय सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ke samay sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, dry, night, falling asleep, on
Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough at night that starts when falling asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को नींद आते समय सूखी खाँसी शुरू हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ko nind aate samay sukhi khansi shuru ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, dry, night, first, followed by profuse salty expectoration with pain as if something were torn loose from larynx
Linked to time of day.en: At night, the cough starts dry but is then followed by bringing up a large amount of salty mucus, with a pain in the throat as if something is being torn loose.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को पहले सूखी खाँसी आती है, फिर खूब नमकीन बलगम निकलता है और गले में ऐसा दर्द होता है जैसे कुछ खिंचकर टूट गया हो।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ko pehle sukhi khansi aati hai, phir khoob namkin balgam nikalta hai aur gale mein aisa dard hota hai jaise kuch chinkhar toot gya ho.

Linked to time of day.en: A dry cough at night that gets worse when breathing in.

Comes with other symptoms.en: A dry cough where after each breath out there is a flush of heat and sweating.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: साँस बाहर छोड़ने के बाद सूखी खाँसी आती है और साथ में गर्मी की लहर और पसीना आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sans bahar chhorne ke baad sukhi khansi aati hai aur sath mein garmi ki lehar aur pasina aata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: A dry cough associated with fever.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बुखार के साथ सूखी खाँसी है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Bukhar ke sath sukhi khansi hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: A dry cough that occurs during a fever.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बुखार आने के दौरान सूखी खाँसी होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Bukhar aane ke dauran sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: A dry cough that comes on just before an attack of intermittent fever.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बार-बार आने वाले बुखार से पहले सूखी खाँसी होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Bar-bar aane wale bukhar se pehle sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: A dry cough that comes on along with sneezing.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: सूखी खाँसी के साथ छींकें भी आती हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: sukhi khansi ke saath chhinte bhi aati hain.

General.en: A dry cough associated with chills.
General.hi: ठंड लगने पर सूखी खाँसी आती है।
General.roman: Thandi lagne par sukhi khansi aati hai.

General.path: Cough, dry, chronic dry cough in pining boys
General.en: A long-lasting dry cough seen in boys who seem to be pining or failing to thrive.
General.hi: दुबले-पतले, उदास रहने वाले लड़कों को पुरानी सूखी खाँसी रहती है।
General.roman: Duble-patle, udas rahne wale ladkon ko purani sukhi khansi rahti hai.

General.path: Cough, dry, chronic, in scrofulous children
General.en: A long-lasting dry cough seen in children with swollen glands or a tendency to frequent infections.
General.hi: कमज़ोर और दुबले बच्चों को लंबे समय से सूखी खाँसी है।
General.roman: Kamzor aur duble bachchon ko lambe samay se sukhi khansi hai.

General.en: A dry cough that is almost constant.
General.hi: लगभग हर वक्त सूखी खाँसी बनी रहती है।
General.roman: Lagbhag har waqt sukhi khansi bani rahti hai.

General.en: A dry cough seen in boys who are very thin and losing weight.
General.hi: दुबले-पतले लड़कों को सूखी खाँसी रहती है।
General.roman: Duble-patle ladko ko sukhi khansi rahti hai.

General.en: A dry cough that is related to bringing up phlegm or mucus.
General.hi: सूखी खाँसी है, लेकिन बलगम नहीं निकलता।
General.roman: Sukhi khansi hai, lekin balgam nahi nikalta.

General.en: A dry cough that develops after a gonorrhoea infection was suppressed or stopped without proper treatment.
General.hi: पुरानी सुजाक (गोनोरिया) की बीमारी दबाने के बाद सूखी खाँसी शुरू हुई है।
General.roman: Purani sujak (gonorrhea) ki bimari dabane ke baad sukhi khansi shuru hui hai.

General.en: A dry cough related to breathing in.
General.hi: साँस अंदर लेने पर सूखी खाँसी आती है।
General.roman: Sans andar lene par sukhi khansi aati hai.

General.en: A dry cough that developed after having measles.
General.hi: खसरे (measles) की बीमारी के बाद सूखी खाँसी हो गई है।
General.roman: Khasre ki bimari ke baad sukhi khansi ho gayi hai.

Sensation type.en: A dry cough caused by a feeling of tightness or constriction in the throat.
Sensation type.hi: गले में कसाव या जकड़न से सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Sensation type.roman: Gale mein kasav ya jakdan se sukhi khansi aati hai.

Sensation type.en: A dry cough caused by an irritation felt in the voice box area.
Sensation type.hi: गले में खुजली या जलन से सूखी खाँसी होती है।
Sensation type.roman: Gale mein khujli ya jalan se sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, dry, daytime, lying down amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough during the day that gets better when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: दिन में सूखी खाँसी होती है और लेटने पर आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Din mein sukhi khansi hoti hai aur letne par aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, dry, evening, lying down agg.
Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough in the evening that gets worse when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Shaam ko letne par sukhi khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, dry, evening, lying down, amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough in the evening that gets better when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Shaam ko letne par sukhi khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that is related to lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne par sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that gets better when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne par sukhi khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that comes on when lying on the back.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ के बल लेटने से सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Pith ke bal letne se sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that comes on when lying on the back.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ के बल लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Pith ke bal letne par sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, dry, lying, back, on agg.
Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that gets worse when lying on the back.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ के बल लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Pith ke bal letne par sukhi khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, dry, lying, back, on, amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that gets better when lying on the back.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ के बल लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Pith ke bal letne par sukhi khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, dry, lying, back, on, midnight
Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that comes on at midnight when lying on the back.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ के बल लेटने पर आधी रात को सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Pith ke bal letne par aadhi rat ko sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that comes on when lying on the side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: करवट लेकर लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Karvat lekar letne par sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, dry, lying, side, left, agg.
Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that gets worse when lying on the left side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बाईं करवट लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Bain karvat letne par sukhi khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, dry, lying, side, on, amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that gets better when lying on the side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: करवट लेकर लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Karvat lekar letne par sukhi khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, dry, lying, side, right, agg.
Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that gets worse when lying on the right side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: दाईं करवट लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Dain karvat letne par sukhi khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that gets worse while lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne par sukhi khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough at night that gets worse when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko letne par sukhi khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, dry, night, lying, on right side only, while
Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough at night that only occurs when lying on the right side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को केवल दाईं करवट लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko keval dain karvat letne par sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, dry, night, midnight, lying on back
Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough at midnight that comes on while lying on the back.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को आधी रात के समय पीठ के बल लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke samay pith ke bal letne par sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, dry, night, midnight, lying, on side amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough at midnight that gets better when turning to lie on the side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को आधी रात के समय करवट लेकर लेटने पर सूखी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke samay karvat lekar letne par sukhi khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, dry, night, sitting up amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough at night that gets better when sitting up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को उठकर बैठने पर सूखी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko uthkar baithne par sukhi khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that occurs while sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठे रहने पर सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: baithe rahne par sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that gets better when sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठने पर सूखी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: baithne par sukhi khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A dry cough that gets worse while sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठे रहने पर सूखी खाँसी और बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: baithe rahne par sukhi khansi aur badh jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A dry cough during the day that appears just before the menstrual period begins.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी से पहले दिन में सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari se pehle din mein sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A dry cough linked to the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के समय सूखी खाँसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke samay sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A dry cough that comes on just before the menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले सूखी खाँसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ane se pehle sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A dry cough in the morning that comes on just before the menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले सुबह के समय सूखी खाँसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ane se pehle subah ke samay sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A dry cough that occurs during the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ke dauran sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Cough, dry, menses, during, profuse sweat, with
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A dry cough during the menstrual period that comes with heavy sweating.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान सूखी खाँसी के साथ बहुत पसीना आता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ke dauran sukhi khansi ke saath bahut pasina aata hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A dry cough caused by a suppressed or absent menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी रुक जाने की वजह से सूखी खाँसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ruk jane ki wajah se sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A dry cough in the morning linked to the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के समय सुबह सूखी खाँसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ke samay subah sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A dry cough in the morning that comes on just before the menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले सुबह सूखी खाँसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari aane se pehle subah sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A dry cough in the morning linked to a suppressed or absent menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी रुकने पर सुबह सूखी खाँसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari rukne par subah sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A dry cough associated with dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात के खाने के समय सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Raat ke khane ke samay sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A dry cough that gets worse after dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात का खाना खाने के बाद सूखी खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Raat ka khana khane ke baad sukhi khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A dry cough that gets better after dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात का खाना खाने के बाद सूखी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Raat ka khana khane ke baad sukhi khansi me aram milta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Cough, dry, drinking, after, loose after eating
Linked to eating/digestion.en: A dry cough after drinking that becomes loose after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: पीने के बाद सूखी खाँसी आती है, लेकिन खाना खाने के बाद खाँसी में बलगम आ जाता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Pine ke baad sukhi khansi aati hai, lekin khana khane ke baad khansi me balgam aa jata hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A dry cough triggered by eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते समय सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khate samay sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A dry cough that gets better after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने से सूखी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane se sukhi khansi me aram milta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A dry cough that gets worse from eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने से सूखी खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane se sukhi khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A dry cough at night triggered by eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात को खाना खाने के बाद सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Raat ko khana khane ke baad sukhi khansi aati hai.

Discharge.path: Cough, dry, expectoration, hawking, later copious green sputum
Discharge.en: A dry cough that starts with throat-clearing and later produces large amounts of green phlegm.
Discharge.hi: पहले सूखी खाँसी आती है, बाद में खखारने पर काफ़ी मात्रा में हरा बलगम निकलता है।
Discharge.roman: Pehle sukhi khansi aati hai, baad mein khakharne par kafi matra mein hara balgam nikalta hai.

Gas & digestion.path: Cough, dry, flatus, discharge up and down, amel. must sit up also
Gas & digestion.en: A dry cough that gets better when passing wind both upward and downward, and you also need to sit up.
Gas & digestion.hi: ऊपर-नीचे से गैस निकलने पर सूखी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है और साथ में सीधे बैठना भी ज़रूरी लगता है।
Gas & digestion.roman: Upar-niche se gas nikalne par sukhi khansi mein aaram milta hai aur sath mein sidhe baithna bhi zaruri lagta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, dry, scraping in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A dry cough caused by a scraping feeling in the throat/voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में खुरखुराहट के कारण सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: gale mein khurkhurahtt ke karan sukhi khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, dry, stomach, as if from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A dry cough that feels as though it is coming from the stomach.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: खाँसी ऐसी लगती है जैसे पेट से आ रही हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: khansi aisi lagti hai jaise pet se aa rahi ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, dry, tickling in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A dry cough caused by a tickling feeling in the throat/voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में गुदगुदी होने से सूखी खाँसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: gale mein gudgudi hone se sukhi khansi aati hai.

General.en: A cough caused by dryness in the airways.
General.hi: साँस की नली में सूखेपन के कारण खाँसी आती है।
General.roman: Sans ki nali mein sukhepen ke karan khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, dryness air passages, from, chest
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a dry feeling in the chest.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: छाती में सूखापन लगने के कारण खाँसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Chhati mein sukhapan lagne ke karan khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, dryness air passages, from, fauces
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a dry feeling at the back of the throat.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के पिछले हिस्से में सूखापन लगने के कारण खाँसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ke pichle hisse mein sukhapan lagne ke karan khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, dryness air passages, from, in trachea, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a dry feeling in the windpipe.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले की नली (श्वासनली) में सूखापन के कारण खाँसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ki nali (shwasanli) mein sukhapan ke karan khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, dryness air passages, from, larynx
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a dry feeling in the voice box/throat.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: आवाज की नली (स्वरयंत्र) में सूखापन के कारण खाँसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aawaz ki nali (swaryantr) mein sukhapan ke karan khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, dryness air passages, from, larynx, dry spot
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a dry spot in the voice box/throat.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: आवाज की नली में एक सूखी जगह होने के कारण खाँसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aawaz ki nali mein ek sukhi jagah hone ke karan khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, dryness air passages, from, larynx, morning
Linked to time of day.en: A cough caused by a dry feeling in the voice box/throat that occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय आवाज की नली में सूखापन के कारण खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay aawaz ki nali mein sukhapan ke karan khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, dust, as from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough with a sensation as if dust is in the airway.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे धूल के कारण खाँसी आ रही हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise dhul ke karan khansi aa rahi ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, dust, as from, in throat-pit
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough with a feeling as if dust is irritating the area at the base of the throat/pit of the neck.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के नीचे वाले हिस्से में धूल जैसा महसूस होने से खाँसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ke neeche wale hisse mein dhul jaisa mehsus hone se khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, dust, as from, in, trachea
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough with a feeling as if dust is in the windpipe.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले की नली में धूल जैसा महसूस होने से खाँसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ki nali mein dhul jaisa mehsus hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough that gets better when eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाने के बाद खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khane ke baad khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough that gets worse from eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाने के बाद खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khane ke baad khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough that gets worse when eating too quickly or hastily.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: जल्दी-जल्दी खाने पर खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Jaldi-jaldi khane par khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough that gets worse after eating heavily spiced or seasoned food.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: तीखा या मसालेदार खाना खाने पर खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Teekha ya masaledar khana khane par khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough that continues after eating until it causes vomiting.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाँसी तब तक आती रहती है जब तक उल्टी न हो जाए।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khansi tab tak aati rahti hai jab tak ulti na ho jaye.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, elongated uvula, as from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough with a sensation as if the tissue hanging at the back of the throat (uvula) is drooping or elongated.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे गले का काँटा लंबा हो गया हो और उससे खाँसी आ रही हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise gale ka kanta lamba ho gaya ho aur usse khansi aa rahi ho.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, elongated uvula, as from, morning
Linked to time of day.en: A cough in the morning with a sensation as if the tissue at the back of the throat (uvula) is drooping or elongated.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय ऐसा लगता है जैसे गले का काँटा लंबा हो गया हो और उससे खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay aisa lagta hai jaise gale ka kanta lamba ho gaya ho aur usse khansi aati hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A cough that alternates with skin rashes or eruptions — when the cough is present, the rash disappears, and vice versa.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: खाँसी और त्वचा के दाने बारी-बारी से आते हैं — कभी खाँसी तो कभी दाने।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Khansi aur tvcha ke dane bari-bari se aate hain — kabhi khansi to kabhi dane.

Skin/tissue changes.en: A cough that came on after a skin rash was suppressed or treated away.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: त्वचा के दाने दब जाने के कारण खाँसी हुई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Tvcha ke dane dab jane ke karan khansi hui hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on in the evening around 6 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 6 बजे खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 6 baje khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that occurs in the evening between 6 p.m. and 10 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 6 बजे से रात 10 बजे के बीच खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 6 baje se raat 10 baje ke beech khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that occurs in the evening between 6 p.m. and 7 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 6 बजे से 7 बजे के बीच खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 6 baje se 7 baje ke beech khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that occurs in the evening around 6:15 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 6 बजकर 15 मिनट पर खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 6 bajakar 15 minut par khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that occurs in the evening around 6:30 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 6 बजकर 30 मिनट पर खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 6 bajakar 30 minut par khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on in the evening around 7 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 7 बजे खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 7 baje khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on in the evening after 7 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 7 बजे के बाद खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 7 baje ke baad khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on in the evening around 7 p.m. or 8 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 7 बजे या 8 बजे खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 7 baje ya 8 baje khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that occurs in the evening from 7 p.m. continuing until 1 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 7 बजे से रात 1 बजे तक खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 7 baje se raat 1 baje tak khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that occurs in the evening between 7 p.m. and 8 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 7 बजे से 8 बजे के बीच खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko 7 baje se 8 baje ke beech khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on in the evening around 7:30 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 7 बजकर 30 मिनट पर खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko 7 bajakar 30 minut par khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on in the evening around 8 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 8 बजे खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko 8 baje khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that occurs in the evening between 8 p.m. and 11 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 8 बजे से रात 11 बजे के बीच खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko 8 baje se raat 11 baje ke beech khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that occurs in the evening between 8 p.m. and 9 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 8 बजे से 9 बजे के बीच खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko 8 baje se 9 baje ke beech khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on in the evening around 8:30 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 8 बजकर 30 मिनट पर खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko 8 bajakar 30 minut par khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on in the evening around 9 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 9 बजे खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko 9 baje khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that starts in the evening around 9 p.m. and continues until 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को रात 9 बजे से सुबह 4 बजे तक खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko raat 9 baje se subah 4 baje tak khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that starts in the evening around 9 p.m. and continues until morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को रात 9 बजे से सुबह तक खांसी आती रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko raat 9 baje se subah tak khansi aati rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: An evening cough that comes on when going to bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बिस्तर पर जाते समय खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko bistar par jate samay khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: An evening cough that continues until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को आधी रात के समय खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko aadhi raat ke samay khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: An evening cough that continues after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ke baad khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: An evening cough that lasts until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम से लेकर आधी रात तक खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham se lekar aadhi raat tak khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough in the evening that comes on when falling asleep or going to sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को नींद आने के दौरान खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko nind ane ke dauran khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, evening, sleep, after going to
Linked to time of day.en: An evening cough that starts after going to sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को नींद आने के बाद खांसी शुरू होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko nind ane ke baad khansi shuru hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, evening, sleep, on going to
Linked to time of day.en: An evening cough that comes on when first going to sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को नींद आते समय खांसी शुरू हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko nind ate samay khansi shuru ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that occurs only from sunset to sunrise.
Linked to time of day.hi: सूरज डूबने से लेकर सूरज उगने तक (पूरी रात) खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Suraj dubne se lekar suraj ugne tak (puri raat) khansi aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Cough, evening, 9 p.m., about, with fever, followed by burning heat of head, cramps in legs and feet, hands and arms and rapid pulse
Comes with other symptoms.en: A cough in the evening around 9 p.m. accompanied by fever, followed by a burning heat in the head, cramps in the legs, feet, hands and arms, and a rapid pulse.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: शाम को लगभग रात 9 बजे बुखार के साथ खांसी आती है, जिसके बाद सिर में जलन, टांगों और पैरों में ऐंठन, हाथों और बाहों में ऐंठन और नब्ज तेज हो जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sham ko lagbhag raat 9 baje bukhar ke saath khansi aati hai, jiske baad sir mein jalan, tangon aur pairon mein ainthan, hathon aur bahon mein ainthan aur nabz tez ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: An evening cough that comes on while lying in bed.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को बिस्तर में लेटने पर खांसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Sham ko bistar mein letne par khansi aati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Cough, evening, bed, in, menses, before
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: An evening cough in bed that comes on before the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी से पहले शाम को बिस्तर में लेटने पर खांसी आती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari se pehle sham ko bistar mein letne par khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: An evening cough that comes on when going outside.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: शाम को बाहर जाने पर खांसी शुरू हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Sham ko bahar jane par khansi shuru ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: A cough brought on by mental effort or concentration.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: दिमागी मेहनत या सोचने के काम से खांसी आती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Dimagi mehnat ya sochne ke kaam se khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough brought on by vigorous or strenuous physical exertion.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बहुत जोर लगाने या कड़ी मेहनत करने पर खांसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Bahut jor lagane ya kadi mehnat karne par khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that is exhausting and draining, occurring during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन में खांसी आती है और उससे बहुत थकान हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din mein khansi aati hai aur usse bahut thakan ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that is exhausting and draining, occurring in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को खांसी आती है और उससे बहुत थकान हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko khansi aati hai aur usse bahut thakan ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, exhausting, evening, going to sleep, on
Linked to time of day.en: An exhausting cough in the evening that comes on when falling asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को नींद आते समय खांसी आती है और उससे बहुत थकान हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko nind aate samay khansi aati hai aur usse bahut thakan ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that is exhausting and draining, occurring in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह खांसी आती है और उससे बहुत थकान हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah khansi aati hai aur usse bahut thakan ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, exhausting, morning, going to sleep, on
Linked to time of day.en: An exhausting cough in the morning that comes on when falling asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद आते समय खांसी आती है और उससे बहुत थकान हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind aate samay khansi aati hai aur usse bahut thakan ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: An exhausting cough in the morning that comes on after waking up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलने के बाद खांसी आती है और उससे बहुत थकान हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind khulne ke baad khansi aati hai aur usse bahut thakan ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that is exhausting and draining, occurring at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खांसी आती है और उससे बहुत थकान हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko khansi aati hai aur usse bahut thakan ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: An exhausting cough at night that disturbs or interrupts sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खांसी से इतनी थकान होती है कि नींद टूट जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko khansi se itni thakan hoti hai ki nind tut jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is so draining that it leaves you completely exhausted, and it happens around noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर के समय खांसी आती है और उससे बहुत थकान हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ke samay khansi aati hai aur usse bahut thakan ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: An exhausting cough at night that occurs while in bed.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को बिस्तर में लेटने पर खांसी आती है और उससे बहुत थकान हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko bistar mein letne par khansi aati hai aur usse bahut thakan ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, exhausting, night, sitting up amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: An exhausting cough at night that gets better when sitting up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को खांसी से बहुत थकान होती है, लेकिन उठकर बैठने से आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko khansi se bahut thakan hoti hai, lekin uthkar baithe se aram milta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Cough, explosive, escape of fetid, pungent air, with
Comes with other symptoms.en: The cough bursts out suddenly and is accompanied by a rush of foul-smelling, sharp-smelling air.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: खांसी बहुत जोरदार आती है और साथ में बदबूदार, तीखी हवा निकलती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Khansi bahut jordaar aati hai aur saath mein badboodaar, tikkhi hawa nikalties hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough comes in a sudden, violent burst in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को खांसी बहुत जोरदार और विस्फोट जैसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko khansi bahut jordaar aur visfot jaisi aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: The cough occurs while you have a fever.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बुखार के दौरान खांसी आती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Bukhar ke dauran khansi aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: The cough occurs during a fever that goes up and down (remittent fever).
Comes with other symptoms.hi: उतार-चढ़ाव वाले बुखार के दौरान खांसी आती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Utaar-chadav vale bukhar ke dauran khansi aati hai.

General.en: The cough is associated with a recurring (intermittent) fever.
General.hi: बार-बार आने वाले बुखार (मलेरिया जैसे) के साथ खांसी आती है।
General.roman: Bar-bar aane vale bukhar (maleria jaiso) ke saath khansi aati hai.

General.en: The cough came on after a recurring (intermittent) fever was suppressed or driven inward.
General.hi: बार-बार आने वाले बुखार को दबाने के कारण खांसी आती है।
General.roman: Bar-bar aane vale bukhar ko dabane ke kaaran khansi aati hai.

General.en: The cough developed after having scarlet fever.
General.hi: स्कारलेट बुखार (लाल बुखार) के बाद खांसी आती है।
General.roman: Scarlet bukhar (lal bukhar) ke baad khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough comes on after a bout of recurring (intermittent) fever has passed.
Linked to time of day.hi: बार-बार आने वाले बुखार के बाद खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Bar-bar aane vale bukhar ke baad khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, fever, intermittent, before, in spells
Linked to time of day.en: The cough comes on in episodes just before a recurring (intermittent) fever starts.
Linked to time of day.hi: बार-बार आने वाले बुखार से पहले दौरों में खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Bar-bar aane vale bukhar se pehle dauroun mein khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is very strong and forceful, occurring in the evening and at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम और रात को खांसी बहुत जोर से आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam aur raat ko khansi bahut jor se aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, foreign body, sensation as of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation that something foreign is lodged in the airway, which triggers the cough.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में कुछ अटका हुआ सा लगता है जिससे खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein kuch atka hua sa lagta hai jisse khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, foreign body, sensation as of, awn of barley swaying in larynx
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation like a bristle from a grain of barley is swaying back and forth in the voice box, triggering the cough.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में जौ की बाल जैसा कुछ हिलता हुआ महसूस होता है जिससे खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein jau ki baal jaisa kuch hilta hua mehsus hota hai jisse khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, foreign body, sensation as of, in larynx
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation that something foreign is stuck in the voice box, triggering the cough.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में कुछ अटका हुआ महसूस होता है जिससे खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein kuch atka hua mehsus hota hai jisse khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, foreign body, sensation of, in trachea, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation that something foreign is stuck in the windpipe, triggering the cough.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: सांस की नली में कुछ फंसा हुआ लगता है जिससे खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Saans ki nali mein kuch fansa hua lagta hai jisse khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs between 10 a.m. and 12 noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 10 बजे से दोपहर 12 बजे के बीच खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah 10 baje se dopahar 12 baje ke beech khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, forenoon, 10 a.m.; from rawness, in air passages while lying
Linked to time of day.en: At around 10 a.m., lying down causes a raw feeling in the airways that brings on the cough.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 10 बजे लेटने पर सांस की नली में खुरदरापन महसूस होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah 10 baje letne par saans ki nali mein khurdurpan mehsus hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs at around 11 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 11 बजे खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah 11 baje khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, forenoon, 11 a.m., rush of blood to chest, from
Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs at around 11 a.m. and seems to be brought on by a rush of blood to the chest.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 11 बजे सीने में खून का दबाव बढ़ने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah 11 baje sine mein khun ka dabao badhne se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, forenoon, 11 a.m.; dry cough from tickling behind upper half of sternum, while sitting bent forward
Linked to time of day.en: At around 11 a.m., a dry cough is triggered by a tickling feeling behind the upper part of the breastbone, and it happens while sitting bent forward.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 11 बजे आगे की तरफ झुककर बैठने पर सीने की हड्डी के ऊपरी हिस्से में गुदगुदी से सूखी खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah 11 baje aage ki taraf jhukkar baithne par sine ki haddi ke upri hisse mein gudgudi se sukhi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs between 9 a.m. and 10 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 9 बजे से 10 बजे के बीच खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah 9 baje se 10 baje ke beech khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs between 9 a.m. and 12 noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 9 बजे से दोपहर 12 बजे के बीच खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah 9 baje se dopahar 12 baje ke beech khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, forenoon, 9 a.m. to 5 or 6 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs from 9 a.m. through to 5 or 6 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 9 बजे से शाम 5-6 बजे तक खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah 9 baje se shaam 5-6 baje tak khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs in the late morning when waking up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह जागते समय खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah jagte samay khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs in the late morning after waking up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह जागने के बाद खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah jagne ke baad khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is a feeling of fullness or tightness in the chest that brings on the cough in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह सीने में भरापन महसूस होने के साथ खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah sine mein bharapan mehsus hone ke saath khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, grasping, larynx involuntarily, at every cough, feels as though larynx would be torn
Triggered by specific actions.en: During each cough, you involuntarily grab your throat with your hand, and the throat feels as though it is being torn.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खांसते समय बिना इच्छा के गला पकड़ लेते हैं, जैसे लगता है कि गला फट जाएगा।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khaste samay bina ichchha ke gala pakad lete hain, jaise lagta hai ki gala phat jayega.

Triggered by specific actions.en: During coughing, you involuntarily clutch at your throat.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खांसी के दौरान गला पकड़ लेते हैं।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khansi ke dauran gala pakad lete hain.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is a short, dry, repetitive hacking cough that occurs in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद हल्की-हल्की खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad halki-halki khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs at around 2 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद 2 बजे हल्की-हल्की खांसी आती है।
