Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad 2 baje halki-halki khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs at around 3 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद 3 बजे हल्की-हल्की खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad 3 baje halki-halki khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, hacking, afternoon, 3 p.m. to 4 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs between 3 p.m. and 4 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद 3 से 4 बजे के बीच खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad 3 se 4 baje ke beech khankharne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs only during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: din ke samay khankharne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: sham ko khankharne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs at around 6 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 6 बजे खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: sham ko 6 baje khankharne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs at around 7 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 7 बजे खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: sham ko 7 baje khankharne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs in the evening when lying in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बिस्तर पर लेटने पर खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: sham ko bistar par letne par khankharne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs in the late morning (before noon).
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 9 से 12 बजे के बीच (पूर्वाह्न में) खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah 9 se 12 baje ke beech (purvahn mein) khankharne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay khankharne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough in the morning is caused by mucus or phlegm in the throat.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बलगम की वजह से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah balgam ki wajah se khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs in the morning after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने के बाद खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne ke baad khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs in the morning on waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलने पर खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind khulne par khankharne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko khankharne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough goes on both day and night.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन-रात दोनों समय खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din-raat donon samay khankharne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs at night around midnight and wakes you from sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के समय खंखारने वाली खाँसी से नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke samay khankharne wali khansi se nind khul jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs at noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर 12 बजे खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar 12 baje khankharne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, hacking, sleep, when going to
Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough comes on when you are just falling asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: सोने जाते समय खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sone jate samay khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The hacking cough occurs on waking from sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद खुलने पर खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Neend khulne par khankhaarne wali khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The hacking cough is triggered by breathing in air.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हवा लगने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Hawa lagane se khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The hacking cough is triggered by taking a deep breath in.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: गहरी साँस लेने पर खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: gahri sans lene par khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The hacking cough in the evening is brought on by smoking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: शाम को धूम्रपान करने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: sham ko dhumrapan karne se khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The hacking cough in the morning is brought on by talking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: सुबह बात करने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Subah baat karne se khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The hacking cough is brought on or made worse by movement.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हिलने-डुलने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Hilne-dulne se khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Smoking brings on the hacking cough.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: धूम्रपान करने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Dhumpaan karne se khankhaarne wali khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The hacking cough is brought on by walking quickly.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: तेज चलने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Tez chalne se khankhaarne wali khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, hacking, walking, open air, in
Triggered by specific actions.en: The hacking cough comes on when walking in the open air.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खुली हवा में चलने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khuli hawa mein chalne se khankhaarne wali khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Cold air makes the hacking cough worse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडी हवा लगने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi hawa lagane se khankharne wali khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Being in the open air makes the hacking cough worse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: khuli hawa mein jane se khankharne wali khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Being in the open air makes the hacking cough better.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: khuli hawa mein jane se khankharne wali khansi kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: The hacking cough occurs in the evening in a warm room.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: शाम को गर्म कमरे में जाने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: sham ko garam kamre mein jane se khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Heat makes the hacking cough worse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्मी बढ़ने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garmi badhne se khankharne wali khansi badh jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: The hacking cough occurs during a chill or shivering episode.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड लगने (कँपकँपी) के दौरान खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: thandi lagne (kapkapi) ke dauran khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, hacking, crawling in the larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The hacking cough is triggered by a crawling sensation in the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में कुछ रेंगने जैसा लगने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: gale mein kuch rengne jaisa lagne se khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, hacking, dryness in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The hacking cough is caused by a dry feeling in the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में सूखापन लगने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: gale mein sukhapan lagne se khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, hacking, irritation in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The hacking cough is triggered by an irritation or tickling feeling in the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में जलन या चुभन होने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale me jalan ya chuban hone se khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, hacking, night, smothered feeling
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The hacking cough occurs at night with a smothered or suffocating feeling.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: रात को खंखारने वाली खाँसी के साथ दम घुटने जैसा लगता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Raat ko khankharne wali khansi ke sath dum ghutne jaisa lagta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, hacking, rawness in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The hacking cough is triggered by a raw or sore feeling in the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में खुरदरापन या छिला हुआ जैसा लगने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale me khurdrapan ya chhila hua jaisa lagne se khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, hacking, tickling in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The hacking cough is triggered by a tickling feeling in the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में गुदगुदी होने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein gudgudi hone se khankhaarne wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The hacking cough comes on after eating dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात के खाने के बाद खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: rat ke khane ke baad khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The hacking cough is brought on by eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: khane se khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The hacking cough comes on after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: khana khane ke baad khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The hacking cough occurs while eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते समय खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: khana khate samay khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, hacking, evening, lying down, after
Linked to posture/position.en: The hacking cough occurs in the evening after lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को लेटने के बाद खंखारने वाली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: sham ko letne ke baad khankharne wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The hacking cough gets better in the evening when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को लेटने से खंखारने वाली खाँसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: sham ko letne se khankharne wali khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The hacking cough occurs while lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटे रहने पर खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Lete rahne par khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The hacking cough comes on when you get up or rise.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बिस्तर से उठने पर खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Bistar se uthne par khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The hacking cough gets better after getting up or rising.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बिस्तर से उठने पर खंखारने वाली खाँसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Bistar se uthne par khankharne wali khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: Getting up or rising makes the hacking cough worse.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बिस्तर से उठते समय खंखारने वाली खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Bistar se uthte samay khankharne wali khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Cough, hacking, menses, at beginning of
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: The hacking cough begins at the start of the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी शुरू होते ही खंखारने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari shuru hote hi khankharne wali khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: You feel the need to hold onto something with your hands while coughing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाँसते समय हाथों से छाती को थामना पड़ता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khante samay hathon se chhati ko thamna padta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, hands, must hold chest with both, while
Triggered by specific actions.en: You must hold your chest firmly with both hands while coughing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाँसते समय दोनों हाथों से छाती को पकड़ना पड़ता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khante samay donon hathon se chhati ko pakadhna padta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, hands, must hold, holding, abdomen amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: The cough is relieved by pressing on or holding the belly with your hand.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाँसते समय पेट को हाथ से पकड़ने पर आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khante samay pet ko hath se pakdhne par aaram milta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Cough, hands, must hold, holding pit of stomach amel.
Linked to eating/digestion.en: The cough is relieved by pressing on or holding the pit of the stomach (upper-middle belly) with your hand.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाँसते समय पेट के ऊपरी हिस्से (सोलर प्लेक्सस) को हाथ से दबाने पर आराम मिलता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khante samay pet ke uparli hisse ko hath se dabane par aaram milta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is hard and forceful and occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बहुत कड़क और ज़ोरदार खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko bahut kadak aur zordar khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is hard and forceful and occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बहुत कड़क और ज़ोरदार खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko bahut kadak aur zordar khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is hard and forceful and occurs after 1 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 1 बजे के बाद बहुत कड़क और ज़ोरदार खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 1 baje ke baad bahut kadak aur zordar khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The cough is hard and forceful and comes on while smoking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: धूम्रपान करते समय बहुत कड़क और ज़ोरदार खाँसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Dhumpaan karte samay bahut kadak aur zordar khansi aati hai.

Type of pain.path: Cough, hard, spells of, not ceasing until masses of offensive sputa are raised
Type of pain.en: The cough comes in hard spells that do not stop until large amounts of foul-smelling phlegm are coughed up.
Type of pain.hi: बहुत कड़क खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं जो तब तक नहीं रुकते जब तक बदबूदार बलगम न निकल जाए।
Type of pain.roman: Bahut kadak khansi ke daure padte hain jo tab tak nahi rukte jab tak badbudar balgam na nikal jaye.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Throat-clearing or hawking makes the cough worse.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: गला खखारने से खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Gala khakaarne se khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough that comes on after exposure to heat.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्मी के बाद खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garmi ke baad khansi hoti hai.

Temperature sensation.en: A cough associated with a feeling of heat in the chest.
Temperature sensation.hi: छाती में गर्मी लगने से खाँसी होती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Chhati mein garmi lagne se khansi hoti hai.

Temperature sensation.en: A cough with a sensation of burning heat felt deep in the airways (the breathing tubes).
Temperature sensation.hi: साँस की नलियों (ब्रोंकाई) में गर्मी या जलन जैसा लगता है जिससे खाँसी होती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Saans ki naliyon (bronkai) mein garmi ya jaln jaisa lagta hai jisse khansi hoti hai.

General.en: A persistent, wasting cough that appeared after a previously recurring fever was suppressed.
General.hi: बुखार (मलेरिया जैसा बुखार) दबने के बाद लंबे समय से चली आ रही कमज़ोर करने वाली खाँसी है।
General.roman: Bukhar (maleria jaisa bukhar) dabne ke baad lambe samay se chali aa rahi kamzor karne wali khansi hai.

Sounds & movement.path: Cough, hissing, hoarseness, with, raises hand to larynx, which is sensitive to touch
Sounds & movement.en: A hissing cough accompanied by hoarseness, with the throat-pipe feeling so sensitive that you raise your hand to it when you cough.
Sounds & movement.hi: खाँसते समय सीटी जैसी आवाज़ आती है और आवाज़ बैठ जाती है; गला छूने पर दर्द होता है और हाथ गले पर जाता है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Khansте samay siti jaisi awaaz aati hai aur awaaz baith jati hai; gala chhune par dard hota hai aur hath gale par jata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hoarse cough that occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को भारी-भारी (बैठी) आवाज़ में खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko bhari-bhari (baithi) awaaz mein khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hoarse cough that occurs in the evening and continues until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम से आधी रात तक भारी-भारी (बैठी) आवाज़ में खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam se aadhi raat tak bhari-bhari (baithi) awaaz mein khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hoarse cough that occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय भारी-भारी (बैठी) आवाज़ में खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay bhari-bhari (baithi) awaaz mein khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hoarse cough that occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को भारी-भारी (बैठी) आवाज़ में खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko bhari-bhari (baithi) awaaz mein khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hoarse cough that occurs at midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के समय भारी-भारी (बैठी) आवाज़ में खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke samay bhari-bhari (baithi) awaaz mein khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hoarse cough that occurs after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के बाद भारी-भारी (बैठी) आवाज़ में खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke baad bhari-bhari (baithi) awaaz mein khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, hoarse, night, midnight, after, barking 2 a.m. to 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: A hoarse, barking cough that occurs after midnight, between 2 a.m. and 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के बाद भौंकने जैसी (बैठी आवाज़ की) खाँसी आती है जो रात 2 से 5 बजे तक चलती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke baad bhonkne jaisi (baithi awaaz ki) khansi aati hai jo raat 2 se 5 baje tak chalta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, hoarse, night, midnight, before, barking; 11 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: A hoarse, barking cough that occurs before midnight, around 11 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात से पहले, यानी रात 11 बजे, भौंकने जैसी (बैठी आवाज़ की) खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat se pehle, yani raat 11 baje, bhonkne jaisi (baithi awaaz ki) khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A hollow-sounding cough that gets better when you take a deep breath.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: गहरी साँस लेने पर खोखली खाँसी कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Gehri sans lene par khokli khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hollow-sounding cough that occurs during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय खोखली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay khokli khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hollow-sounding cough that occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को खोखली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko khokli khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hollow-sounding cough that occurs in the evening and continues until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को खोखली खाँसी आती है जो आधी रात तक चलती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko khokli khansi aati hai jo aadhi rat tak chaldi hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hollow-sounding cough that occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय खोखली आवाज़ वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay khokli awaz wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hollow-sounding cough that occurs in the morning while still in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बिस्तर में लेटे-लेटे खोखली आवाज़ वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah bistar mein lte-lte khokli awaz wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hollow-sounding cough that comes on in the morning after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने के बाद खोखली आवाज़ वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne ke baad khokli awaz wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hollow-sounding cough that comes on in the morning upon waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलने पर खोखली आवाज़ वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind khulne par khokli awaz wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hollow-sounding cough that occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खोखली आवाज़ वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Rat ko khokli awaz wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A hollow-sounding cough that tends to come on around noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर होते-होते खोखली आवाज़ वाली खाँसी होने लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar hote-hote khokli awaz wali khansi hone lagti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, hollow, evening, lying down, after
Linked to posture/position.en: A hollow-sounding cough that comes on in the evening after lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को लेटने के बाद खोखली खाँसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Shaam ko letne ke baad khokli khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A hollow-sounding cough that gets better when you sit up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सीधे बैठने पर खोखली खाँसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Sidhe baithe par khokli khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A hollow-sounding cough that gets worse when you bend forward or stoop down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: आगे की तरफ झुकने पर खोखली खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Age ki taraf jhukne par khokli khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough that is triggered by hunger.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: भूख की वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Bhukh ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: A cough that comes with an intense feeling of hunger.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बहुत तेज़ भूख लगने के साथ खाँसी होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Bahut tej bhukh lagne ke saath khansi hoti hai.

Linked to mood/emotion.path: Cough, hysterical attack of, followed by crying, night
Linked to mood/emotion.en: A hysterical coughing episode at night that is followed by crying.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: रात को हिस्टीरिया जैसी खाँसी का दौरा पड़ता है और उसके बाद रोना आता है।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Rat ko hysteria jaisi khansi ka daura padta hai aur uske baad rona ata hai.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: A hysterical coughing episode that tends to occur in women.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: महिलाओं को हिस्टीरिया जैसी खाँसी का दौरा पड़ता है।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Mahilaon ko hysteria jaisi khansi ka daura padta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Cough, ice cream, at first amel., then agg.
Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough that is temporarily relieved by ice cream at first, but then gets worse afterwards.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: आइसक्रीम खाने से पहले खाँसी में थोड़ी राहत मिलती है, फिर बाद में बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Aiscream khane se pehle khansi me thodi rahat milti hai, phir baad me badh jati hai.

Type of pain.en: An inability to cough because of pain.
Type of pain.hi: दर्द की वजह से खाँसी नहीं हो पाती।
Type of pain.roman: Dard ki wajah se khansi nahi ho pati.

Type of pain.en: Pain that prevents you from being able to cough.
Type of pain.hi: दर्द के कारण खाँसी नहीं निकल पाती।
Type of pain.roman: Dard ke karan khansi nahi nikal pati.

Type of pain.path: Cough, inability to, pain, from, amel. by pressure of hand on pit of stomach
Type of pain.en: Pain that stops you from coughing, which gets better when you press your hand firmly against the pit of your stomach.
Type of pain.hi: पेट के ऊपरी हिस्से पर हाथ से दबाने पर दर्द कम होता है और खाँसी हो पाती है।
Type of pain.roman: Pet ke upri hisse par haath se dabane par dard kam hota hai aur khansi ho pati hai.

Type of pain.path: Cough, inability to, pain, from, in side, from
Type of pain.en: Pain in the side that prevents you from being able to cough.
Type of pain.hi: बगल में दर्द की वजह से खाँसी नहीं हो पाती।
Type of pain.roman: Bagal me dard ki wajah se khansi nahi ho pati.

Sounds & movement.path: Cough, inhalation, crowing, violent, spasmodic cough, beginning with gasping for breath, and continuing with repeated crowing inhalations till face becomes black or purple and patient exhausted, agg. night and after a meal
Sounds & movement.en: A violent, spasmodic cough that begins with gasping for breath and continues with repeated crowing sounds on each breath in, until the face turns black or purple and you are completely exhausted — gets worse at night and after eating a meal.
Sounds & movement.hi: साँस खींचते वक्त खाँसी शुरू होती है — पहले हाँफना, फिर बार-बार घरघराहट के साथ साँस लेना, चेहरा नीला या बैंगनी पड़ जाता है, थकान हो जाती है; रात को और खाने के बाद यह और बढ़ जाती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Sans khinchte waqt khansi shuru hoti hai — pehle haufna, phir baar-baar gargharahat ke saath sans lena, chehra nila ya baingni pad jata hai, thakan ho jati hai; raat ko aur khane ke baad yeh aur badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough that keeps getting interrupted, occurring after dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद खाँसी रुक-रुककर आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad khansi ruk-rukkar aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough that keeps getting interrupted, triggered by smoking in the evening.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: शाम को बीड़ी/सिगरेट पीने से खाँसी रुक-रुककर आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Shaam ko bidi/sigret pine se khansi ruk-rukkar aati hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, interrupted, infiltration of lower chest, from
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough that keeps getting interrupted, caused by thickening or congestion in the lower part of the chest.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: फेफड़ों के निचले हिस्से में जमाव की वजह से खाँसी रुक-रुककर आती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Fefdon ke nichle hisse me jamav ki wajah se khansi ruk-rukkar aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: An irritable cough that comes on in the morning after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने के बाद चिड़चिड़ापन देने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne ke baad chidchidapan dene wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: An irritable cough that comes on at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को चिड़चिड़ापन देने वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko chidchidapan dene wali khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough triggered by irritation felt in the breathing passages.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: साँस की नलियों में जलन या खुजली से खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Sans ki naliyon mein jalan ya khujli se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, larynx in, from, as if some fluid had gone the wrong way
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by irritation in the voice box (larynx), feeling as though liquid has gone down the wrong way.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: जैसे कोई तरल चीज़ गलत रास्ते चली गई हो — ऐसी जलन से गले में खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Jaise koi taral chiz galat raste chali gai ho — aisi jalan se gale mein khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, afternoon
Linked to time of day.en: A cough triggered by irritation in the breathing passages, occurring in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद साँस की नलियों में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad sans ki naliyon mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, evening
Linked to time of day.en: A cough triggered by irritation in the breathing passages, occurring in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को साँस की नलियों में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko sans ki naliyon mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, evening, 7-30 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: A cough triggered by irritation in the breathing passages, occurring in the evening around 7:30 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को साढ़े सात बजे साँस की नलियों में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko sade saat baje sans ki naliyon mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, larynx in, from, afternoon
Linked to time of day.en: A cough caused by irritation in the voice box (larynx), occurring in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद गले की नली में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad gale ki nali mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, larynx in, from, afternoon, 2 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: A cough caused by irritation in the voice box (larynx), occurring in the afternoon around 2 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर 2 बजे गले की नली में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar 2 baje gale ki nali mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, larynx in, from, evening
Linked to time of day.en: A cough caused by irritation in the voice box (larynx), occurring in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को गले की नली में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko gale ki nali mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, larynx in, from, midnight, before
Linked to time of day.en: A cough caused by irritation in the voice box (larynx), occurring before midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले गले की नली में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle gale ki nali mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, larynx in, from, morning
Linked to time of day.en: A cough caused by irritation in the voice box (larynx), occurring in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के वक्त गले की नली में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke waqt gale ki nali mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, lungs, 8 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: A cough triggered by irritation in the lungs, occurring around 8 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 8 बजे फेफड़ों में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat 8 baje fefdon mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, morning, rising after
Linked to time of day.en: A cough triggered by irritation in the breathing passages, coming on in the morning after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने के बाद साँस की नलियों में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne ke baad sans ki naliyom mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, night, on waking
Linked to time of day.en: A cough triggered by irritation in the breathing passages, coming on at night upon waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को नींद खुलने पर साँस की नलियों में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko nind khulne par sans ki naliyom mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, bronchia
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation in the breathing tubes (bronchial airways).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: साँस की छोटी नलियों (ब्रोंकाई) में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Sans ki chhoti naliyon (bronkai) mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, bronchia, bifurcation of
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation at the point where the two main breathing tubes branch apart.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: जहाँ साँस की नली दो भागों में बँटती है, वहाँ जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Jahan sans ki nali do bhagon mein batti hai, wahan jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, bronchia, right
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation in the right breathing tube (right bronchus).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: दाहिनी साँस की नली (ब्रोंकस) में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Dahini sans ki nali (bronkus) mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, cardiac region
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation felt in the region of the heart.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: दिल के आसपास के हिस्से में जलन महसूस होने से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Dil ke aaspas ke hisse mein jalan mehsus hone se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, chest
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation felt in the chest.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: छाती में जलन की वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Chhati mein jalan ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, chest, in
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation deep inside the chest.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: छाती के अंदर जलन की वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Chhati ke andar jalan ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, chest, in, lower
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation in the lower part of the chest.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: छाती के निचले हिस्से में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Chhati ke niche hisse mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, chest, in, upper
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation in the upper part of the chest.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: छाती के ऊपरी हिस्से में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Chhati ke upar hisse mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, fauces
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation felt at the back of the throat (the fauces area).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले के पिछले हिस्से (फॉसेज़) में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale ke pichhe hisse (fossez) mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, larynx in
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation felt in the voice box (larynx).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले की नली (स्वर यंत्र/लेरिंक्स) में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale ki nali (svar yantr/larynks) mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, larynx in, from
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough caused by irritation in the voice box (larynx).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले की नली में जलन की वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale ki nali mein jalan ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, lungs
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation felt in the lungs.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: फेफड़ों में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Fefdon mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, lungs, in, from
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough caused by irritation felt inside the lungs.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: फेफड़ों के अंदर जलन की वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Fefdon ke andar jalan ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, lungs, right
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation in the right lung.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: दाहिने फेफड़े में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Daahine fefd mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, throat-pit, in, from
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation felt at the hollow of the throat (the throat-pit).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले के नीचे की जगह (थ्रोट-पिट) में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale ke neeche ki jagah (throat-pit) mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, thyroid gland, in region of
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation felt in the region of the thyroid gland in the neck.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले में थायरॉइड ग्रंथि के आसपास जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale mein thyroid granthi ke aaspas jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, trachea, in, from
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by irritation felt in the windpipe (trachea).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: साँस की मुख्य नली (ट्रेकिया) में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Sans ki mukhya nali (trachea) mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, epigastrium, in, from
Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough triggered by irritation felt in the upper-middle belly area.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: पेट के ऊपरी हिस्से में जलन महसूस होने से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Pet ke upar hisse mein jalan mehsus hone se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, larynx in, from, eating, while
Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough caused by irritation in the voice box (larynx) that occurs while eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते वक्त गले की नली में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khate waqt gale ki nali mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, evening, bed, in
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough triggered by irritation in the breathing passages while lying in bed in the evening.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को बिस्तर पर लेटने पर साँस की नलियों में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Shaam ko bistar par letne par sans ki naliyon mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, larynx in, from, evening, bed, in
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough caused by irritation in the voice box (larynx) while lying in bed in the evening.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को बिस्तर पर लेटने के बाद गले की नली में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Shaam ko bistar par letne ke baad gale ki nali mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, larynx in, from, evening, lying while
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough caused by irritation in the voice box (larynx) while lying down in the evening.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को लेटे हुए गले की नली में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Shaam ko lete hue gale ki nali mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, larynx in, from, sleep, in first, when lying on side
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough caused by irritation in the voice box (larynx) during the first part of sleep, when lying on the side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पहली नींद में करवट लेकर सोते समय गले की नली में जलन से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Pehli nind mein karvat lekar sote samay gale ki nali mein jalan se khansi hoti hai.

General.path: Cough, irritation in air passages, from, increases the more one coughs
General.en: A cough where the irritation in the breathing passages gets worse the more you cough.
General.hi: जितना खाँसते हैं, साँस की नलियों में जलन उतनी ही बढ़ती जाती है।
General.roman: Jitna khante hain, sans ki naliyon mein jalan utni hi badhti jati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, itching, in chest
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough with an itching sensation felt in the chest.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: छाती में खुजली की वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Chhaati mein khujli ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, itching, in chest, extending through trachea to tip of nose
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough with an itching sensation in the chest that spreads along the windpipe all the way to the tip of the nose.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: छाती में खुजली होती है जो साँस की नली से होती हुई नाक की नोक तक जाती है और खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Chhaati mein khujli hoti hai jo sans ki nali se hoti hui nak ki nok tak jati hai aur khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, itching, in larynx
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough with an itching sensation felt in the voice box (larynx).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले की नली (लेरिंक्स) में खुजली की वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ki nali (larynx) mein khujli ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, itching, trachea, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough triggered by an itching sensation in the windpipe (trachea).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: साँस की मुख्य नली (ट्रेकिया) में खुजली की वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Sans ki mukhya nali (trachea) mein khujli ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A loose, productive cough that occurs in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद बलगम वाली खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, loose, afternoon, dry in morning
Linked to time of day.en: A cough that is loose and productive in the afternoon but dry in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद बलगम वाली खाँसी होती है जबकि सुबह सूखी खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad balgam wali khansi hoti hai jabki subah sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough that occurs during a fever-free period.
Linked to time of day.hi: बुखार न होने पर भी बलगम वाली खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Bukhar na hone par bhi balgam wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough that occurs during the daytime only.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय बलगम वाली खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, loose, daytime, dry at night
Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough during the day that turns dry at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन में बलगम वाली खांसी होती है और रात में सूखी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din mein balgam wali khansi hoti hai aur raat mein sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough that occurs both during the day and at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन और रात दोनों समय बलगम वाली खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din aur raat donon samay balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough that comes on in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय बलगम वाली खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ke samay balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough that comes on at 7 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 7 बजे बलगम वाली खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 7 baje balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, loose, evening, dry in morning
Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough in the evening that is dry in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बलगम वाली खांसी होती है और सुबह सूखी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko balgam wali khansi hoti hai aur subah sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough that occurs in the late morning (before noon).
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 9 से 12 बजे के बीच बलगम वाली खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah 9 se 12 baje ke beech balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough that occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय बलगम वाली खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough in the morning that becomes tight and dry in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बलगम वाली खांसी होती है और दोपहर बाद सूखी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah balgam wali khansi hoti hai aur dopahar baad sukhi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough that occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात के समय बलगम वाली खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ke samay balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, loose, night, less free during day
Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough that is worse at night and less free during the day.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बलगम वाली खांसी ज़्यादा होती है और दिन में कम।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko balgam wali khansi zyada hoti hai aur din mein kam.

Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough that occurs at midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के समय बलगम वाली खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke samay balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A loose, rattling cough that occurs after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के बाद बलगम वाली खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ko aadhi raat ke baad balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A loose, rattling cough that comes on after breakfast.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: नाश्ते के बाद बलगम वाली खांसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Nashte ke baad balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A loose, rattling cough that comes on while eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते समय बलगम वाली खांसी आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khate samay balgam wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A loose, rattling cough that comes on after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद बलगम वाली खांसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Cough, loose, eating, dry after drinking
Linked to eating/digestion.en: A loose, rattling cough while eating that turns dry after drinking.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते समय खांसी बलगम वाली होती है, लेकिन पानी पीने के बाद सूखी हो जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khate samay khansi balgam wali hoti hai, lekin pani pine ke baad sukhi ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, loose, drinking cold water amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: A loose, rattling cough that gets better from drinking cold water.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: ठंडा पानी पीने से बलगम वाली खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Thanda pani pine se balgam wali khansi kam ho jati hai.

Discharge.en: A loose, rattling cough that brings up mucus or phlegm.
Discharge.hi: खांसी बलगम वाली है और बलगम निकलता है।
Discharge.roman: Khansi balgam wali hai aur balgam nikalta hai.

General sensation.en: A loose, rattling cough that produces no mucus or phlegm despite sounding productive.
General sensation.hi: खांसी बलगम वाली लगती है लेकिन बलगम नहीं निकलता।
General sensation.roman: Khansi balgam wali lagti hai lekin balgam nahi nikalta.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, loose, expectoration, without, exercise and warm room agg.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A loose, rattling cough with no mucus coming up, and the cough gets worse with exercise or in a warm room.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खांसी बलगम वाली लगती है पर बलगम नहीं निकलता, और कसरत करने से या गर्म कमरे में जाने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Khansi balgam wali lagti hai par balgam nahi nikalta, aur kasrat karne se ya garm kamre mein jane se khansi badh jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: A loose, rattling cough that occurs during a fever.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बुखार के दौरान बलगम वाली खांसी होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Bukhar ke dauran balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A loose, rattling cough at night that comes on while lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को लेटने पर बलगम वाली खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko letne par balgam wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, loose, night, midnight, sitting up, amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: A loose, rattling cough at midnight that gets better when sitting up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को आधी रात के बाद उठकर बैठने से बलगम वाली खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: raat ko aadhi raat ke baad uthkar baithne se balgam wali khansi kam ho jati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, loose, skin hanging in throat, sensation of, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A loose, rattling cough triggered by the sensation of a loose flap of skin hanging in the throat.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में कुछ लटकता हुआ महसूस होने से बलगम वाली खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: gale mein kuch latka hua mehsoos hone se balgam wali khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, loose, tickling deep in chest, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A loose, rattling cough triggered by a tickling sensation deep in the chest.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: छाती में गहराई में गुदगुदी होने से बलगम वाली खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: chhati mein gahrai mein gudgudi hone se balgam wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets better when lying on the belly.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पेट के बल लेटने से खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: pet ke bal letne se khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on in the afternoon when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: दोपहर बाद लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: dopahar baad letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on when lying down at 2 p.m.
Linked to posture/position.hi: दोपहर 2 बजे लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: dopahar 2 baje letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on when lying down at 3 p.m.
Linked to posture/position.hi: दोपहर 3 बजे लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: dopahar 3 baje letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets worse when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: letne se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets better when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने से खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: letne se khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on when lying on the back.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ के बल लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: pith ke bal letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that occurs specifically while lying on the back.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ के बल लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: pith ke bal letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets worse when lying on the back.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ के बल लेटने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: pith ke bal letne se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets better when lying on the back.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ के बल लेटने से खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: pith ke bal letne se khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, lying, back, on, better than either side, though worse lying on left side
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that is worse lying on the left side but better lying on the back, even though lying on the back is not as good as either side on its own.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ के बल लेटना बाईं करवट से बेहतर है, पर बाईं करवट लेटने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: pith ke bal letna bayin karvat se behtar hai, par bayin karvat letne se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on when lying in bed.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बिस्तर पर लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: bistar par letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets worse when lying in bed.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बिस्तर पर लेटने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: bistar par letne se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, lying, bed, must sit up, or sleep in chair from sense of suffocation
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough when lying in bed so severe that you must sit up or sleep in a chair because of a feeling of suffocation.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बिस्तर पर लेटने से दम घुटने जैसा लगता है और उठकर बैठना पड़ता है या कुर्सी पर बैठकर सोना पड़ता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: bistar par letne se dam ghutne jaisa lagta hai aur uthkar baithna padta hai ya kursi par baiththkar sona padta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets better when lying down during the daytime.
Linked to posture/position.hi: दिन में लेटने पर खांसी कम होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Din mein letne par khansi kam hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on when lying down in the evening.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Shaam ko letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets worse when lying down in the evening.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को लेटने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Shaam ko letne se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets better when lying down in the evening.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को लेटने से खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Shaam ko letne se khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, lying, evening, must sit up
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough when lying down in the evening that forces you to sit up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को लेटने पर खांसी होती है और उठकर बैठना पड़ता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Shaam ko letne par khansi hoti hai aur uthkar baithna padta hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, lying, first lying down, on
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that starts as soon as you first lie down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पहली बार लेटते ही खांसी शुरू हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Pehli bar letate hi khansi shuru ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, lying, hands and knees on, amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets better when on hands and knees.
Linked to posture/position.hi: हाथों और घुटनों के बल झुककर बैठने से खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Hathon aur ghutno ke bal jhukkar baithne se khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that is related to the position of the head when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने पर सिर की स्थिति से खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne par sir ki sthiti se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on when lying with the head low.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटते समय सिर नीचे रखने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letate samay sir niche rakhne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets better when the head is raised while lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटते समय सिर ऊँचा रखने से खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letate samay sir uncha rakhne se khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, lying, long in one position (or sitting) agg.
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets worse after staying in one position for a long time while lying down or sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: एक ही स्थिति में देर तक लेटे रहने से या बैठे रहने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Ek hi sthiti mein der tak lete rehne se ya bathe rehne se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on at night when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, lying, night, as soon as head touches pillow
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough at night that starts as soon as the head touches the pillow.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को लेटते ही सिर तकिये को छूते ही खांसी शुरू हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko letate hi sir takiye ko chhute hi khansi shuru ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on when lying down at midnight.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को आधी रात को लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ko letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on when lying down after midnight.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को आधी रात के बाद लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke baad letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on when lying down before midnight.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को आधी रात से पहले लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat se pehle letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets better while asleep at night when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को सोते समय खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko sote samay khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on when lying down and waking at night.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को नींद खुलने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko nind khulne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets better when lying down around noon.
Linked to posture/position.hi: दोपहर को लेटने से खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: dophar ko letne se khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that only happens when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: खांसी केवल लेटने पर ही होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: khansi keval letne par hi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, lying, only when lying down; was forced to sit up and cough it out, then had rest
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that only happens when lying down and forces you to sit up and cough it out before you can rest again.
Linked to posture/position.hi: खांसी केवल लेटने पर होती है और उठकर बैठकर खांसने के बाद ही आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: khansi keval letne par hoti hai aur uthkar baithkar khansne ke baad hi aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that is affected by which side you lie on.
Linked to posture/position.hi: करवट लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: karavat letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on when lying on the left side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बाईं करवट लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: bai karavat letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, lying, side, left, turning to right side amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough when lying on the left side that gets better when turning to the right side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बाईं करवट से दाईं करवट करने पर खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: bai karavat se dai karavat karne par khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets worse when lying on either side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: करवट लेटने पर दर्द के साथ खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: karavat letne par dard ke sath khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on when lying on the right side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: दाईं करवट लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: dai karavat letne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that comes on at night when lying on the right side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को दाईं करवट लेटने पर खांसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: rat ko dai karavat letne par khansi hoti hai.

Discharge.path: Cough, lying, face, great rattling of mucus, which appears to be low down in chest, while cough does not seem to reach there, only to throat-pit, consequently hard cough does not reach phlegm unless he lie on his face when he brings up a greenish-yellow o
Discharge.en: A cough when lying down with a loud rattling of mucus that seems to be deep in the chest, but the cough only seems to reach the throat; hard coughing does not bring up the phlegm unless lying face-down, when a greenish-yellow mucus is brought up.
Discharge.hi: लेटने पर छाती में काफी नीचे बलगम की घड़घड़ाहट होती है, पर खांसी केवल गले तक पहुँचती है और बलगम नहीं निकलता; मुँह के बल लेटने पर हरे-पीले रंग का बलगम निकलता है।
Discharge.roman: Letne par chhati mein kafi niche balgam ki ghargharahat hoti hai, par khansi keval gale tak pahunchti hai aur balgam nahi nikalta; munh ke bal letne par hare-pile rang ka balgam nikalta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, lying, night, midnight, wakens him
Linked to time of day.en: A cough at midnight while lying down that wakes you up.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात को खांसी आकर नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ko khansi aakar nind khul jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: A cough that comes on after having had measles.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: खसरा ठीक होने के बाद खांसी होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: khasra theek hone ke baad khansi hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: A cough that occurs during measles.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: खसरे की बीमारी के दौरान खांसी होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: khasre ki bimari ke dauran khansi hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Cough, measles, during, eruption develops, which amel.
Comes with other symptoms.en: A cough during measles that gets better as the measles rash comes out on the skin.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: खसरे के दौरान दाने निकलने पर खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: khasre ke dauran dane nikalne par khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough during measles that occurs in the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: खसरे के दौरान दिन में खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: khasre ke dauran din me khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A cough that comes on before the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले खांसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ane se pehle khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A cough before the menstrual period that occurs in the daytime.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले दिन में खांसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ane se pehle din me khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A cough before the menstrual period that comes on in the evening.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले शाम को खांसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: mahwari ane se pehle shaam ko khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Cough, menses, before, evening, bed, in, sitting up amel.
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A cough before the menstrual period in the evening while in bed that gets better when sitting up.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले शाम को बिस्तर पर लेटने पर खांसी होती है और बैठने पर कम हो जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari aane se pehle shaam ko bistar par letne par khansi hoti hai aur baithne par kam ho jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A hysterical-type cough that comes on before the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी से पहले हिस्टीरिया जैसी खांसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari se pehle hysteria jaisi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A cough before the menstrual period that comes on in the morning.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले सुबह खांसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari aane se pehle subah khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A cough before the menstrual period that comes on early in the morning.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले सुबह जल्दी खांसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari aane se pehle subah jaldi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A cough that comes on at the very beginning of the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी शुरू होते ही खांसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari shuru hote hi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A cough that occurs during the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान खांसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A cough during the menstrual period accompanied by a runny nose.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान नाक बहने के साथ खांसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran nak bahne ke saath khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A cough that comes on every evening during the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान हर शाम को खाँसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran har shaam ko khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A hysterical-type cough that occurs during the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान hysteria जैसी खाँसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran hysteria jaisi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A cough during the menstrual period that comes on in the morning.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान सुबह के समय खाँसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran subah ke samay khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Cough, menses, during, roughness in throat, from
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A cough during the menstrual period triggered by a rough or scratchy feeling in the throat.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान गले में खुरदरापन महसूस होने से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran gale mein khurdraapan mehsus hone se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A cough caused by a suppressed or stopped menstrual period.

Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ke barah baje ke baad subah hone tak khanski hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs before midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात से पहले खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat se pehle khanski aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough only happens at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: खाँसी केवल रात को ही आती है, दिन में नहीं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Khanski keval raat ko hi aati hai, din mein nahi.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough at night comes on after getting up out of bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को उठने के बाद खाँसी शुरू हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko uthne ke baad khansi shuru ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, night, waking from the cough
Linked to time of day.en: The cough at night wakes the person from sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खाँसी की वजह से नींद टूट जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko khansi ki wajah se nind tut jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, night, waking from the cough, 1 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: The cough wakes the person from sleep at 1 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 1 बजे खाँसी आकर नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 1 baje khansi aakar nind khul jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, night, waking from the cough, 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: The cough wakes the person from sleep at 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 2 बजे खाँसी आकर नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 2 baje khansi aakar nind khul jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, night, waking from the cough, 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: The cough wakes the person from sleep at 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 3 बजे खाँसी आकर नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 3 baje khansi aakar nind khul jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, night, waking from the cough, 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: The cough wakes the person from sleep at 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 4 बजे खाँसी आकर नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 4 baje khansi aakar nind khul jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, night, waking from the cough, 4 a.m., until
Linked to time of day.en: The cough wakes the person from sleep and continues until 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खाँसी आती है और सुबह 4 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko khansi aati hai aur subah 4 baje tak nind nahi aati.

Comes with other symptoms.en: The cough at night comes with sweating.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: रात को खाँसी के साथ-साथ पसीना भी आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Raat ko khanski ke saath-saath pasina bhi aata hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: Lying down at noon makes the cough better.
Linked to posture/position.hi: दोपहर को लेटने पर खाँसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Dopahar ko letne par khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs during sleep around noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर को नींद में खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ko nind mein khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Elderly people get a chronic cough in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: बुजुर्गों को सुबह के समय पुरानी खाँसी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Bujurgo ko subah ke samay purani khansi rehti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Elderly people get this cough at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: बुजुर्गों को रात में खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Bujurgo ko raat mein khansi aati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Elderly people get this cough in winter.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: बुजुर्गों को सर्दियों में खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Bujurgo ko sardiyon mein khansi hoti hai.

Type of pain.en: The cough causes pain in the voice box (throat area).
Type of pain.hi: खाँसते समय गले (स्वरयंत्र) में दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: khanste samay gale (svar yantr) mein dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: The cough causes pain in the windpipe.
Type of pain.hi: खाँसते समय श्वास नली में दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: khanste samay shvās nali mein dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: The cough is painful in the evening when in bed.
Type of pain.hi: शाम को बिस्तर पर लेटने के बाद खाँसते समय दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: shaam ko bistar par letne ke baad khanste samay dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: The cough is painful and wakes the person just before midnight.
Type of pain.hi: आधी रात से पहले खाँसी से नींद खुलती है और दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: aadhi raat se pehle khansi se neend khulti hai aur dard hota hai.

Type of pain.en: The cough is painful at night.
Type of pain.hi: रात को खाँसी आने पर दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: raat ko khansi aane par dard hota hai.

Sounds & movement.path: Cough, panting, audible rumbling in chest from above downward
Sounds & movement.en: The cough comes in panting bursts with an audible rumbling in the chest moving from top to bottom.
Sounds & movement.hi: खाँसते समय साँस फूलती है और छाती में ऊपर से नीचे की तरफ गड़गड़ाहट की आवाज़ आती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: khanste samay saans phulti hai aur chhati mein upar se neeche ki taraf gadgadahat ki awaz aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: A panting cough that prevents falling asleep.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: साँस फूलने के साथ खाँसी आती है जिससे नींद नहीं आती।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: saans phulne ke saath khansi aati hai jisse neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: The coughing fits occur in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद खाँसी दौरों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: dopahar baad khansi dauron mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The coughing fits occur in the afternoon around 1:30 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद डेढ़ बजे (1:30 बजे) खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: dopahar baad dedh baje (1:30 baje) khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: The coughing fits occur in the afternoon around 2 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद 2 बजे खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: dopahar baad 2 baje khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: The coughing fits occur in the afternoon around 4 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद 4 बजे खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: dopahar baad 4 baje khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: The coughing fits occur in the afternoon around 5 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद 5 बजे खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: dopahar baad 5 baje khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, paroxysmal, afternoon, 5 p.m. to 9 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: The coughing fits occur from 5 p.m. through to 9 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 5 बजे से रात 9 बजे तक खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: shaam ko 5 baje se raat 9 baje tak khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: The coughing fits are worse during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय खाँसी के दौरे और बढ़ जाते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay khansi ke daure aur badh jate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: The coughing fits are better during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय खाँसी के दौरे कम हो जाते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay khansi ke daure kam ho jate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: The coughing fits occur in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: The coughing fits occur in the evening around 6:15 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 6:15 बजे के आसपास खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 6:15 baje ke aaspas khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: The coughing fits occur in the evening around 7 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 7 बजे खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 7 baje khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks in the evening while lying in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बिस्तर पर लेटने पर खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko bistar par letne par khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks in the evening and continue until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम से आधी रात तक खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते रहते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham se aadhi raat tak khansi ke daure padte rehte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks during the late morning (before noon).
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के पूर्वार्द्ध में (दोपहर से पहले) खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke purvardh mein (dopahar se pehle) khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks in the morning while still in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बिस्तर पर लेटे-लेटे खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah bistar par lete-lete khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks in the morning after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने के बाद खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne ke baad khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks in the morning after waking up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलने के बाद खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind khulne ke baad khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, paroxysmal, night, bed, before going to
