Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks at night before going to bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को सोने जाने से पहले खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko sone jane se pehle khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, paroxysmal, night, every other, on falling asleep
Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks every other night, happening as you fall asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: हर दूसरी रात, नींद आते समय खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Har dusri raat, nind ate samay khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks at midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के समय खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke samay khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के बाद खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke baad khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, paroxysmal, night, midnight, after, 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks after midnight, around 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 2 बजे के बाद खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 2 baje ke baad khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, paroxysmal, night, midnight, after, 2 a.m. and 3-30 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks after midnight, around 2 a.m. and again around 3:30 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 2 बजे और 3:30 बजे खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 2 baje aur 3:30 baje khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks before midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात से पहले खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat se pehle khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, paroxysmal, night, midnight, before, 11 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks before midnight, around 11 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 11 बजे खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 11 baje khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, paroxysmal, night, midnight, before, 11 p.m. sleep, after
Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks around 11 p.m. after falling asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 11 बजे नींद आने के बाद खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 11 baje neend aane ke baad khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, paroxysmal, night, midnight, before, 11-30 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks before midnight, around 11:30 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 11:30 बजे खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 11:30 baje khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to time of day.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks from noon through until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर से आधी रात तक खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते रहते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar se aadhi raat tak khansi ke daure padte rahte hain.

General.path: Cough, paroxysmal, attacks follow one another quickly
General.en: During a coughing fit, one attack follows quickly on the heels of the last.
General.hi: खाँसी के दौरे एक के बाद एक बहुत जल्दी-जल्दी आते हैं।
General.roman: khansi ke daure ek ke baad ek bahut jaldi-jaldi aate hain.

General.path: Cough, paroxysmal, attacks follow, first the strongest, following ones weaker and weaker
General.en: During a coughing fit, the first attack is the strongest and each one after gets weaker and weaker.
General.hi: खाँसी के दौरे में पहला झटका सबसे तेज होता है, फिर बाद के झटके धीरे-धीरे कमज़ोर होते जाते हैं।
General.roman: khansi ke daure mein pehla jhatka sabse tez hota hai, phir baad ke jhatke dhire-dhire kamzor hote jate hain.

General.path: Cough, paroxysmal, breath, gasping for, begins with
General.en: A coughing fit that begins with gasping for breath.
General.hi: खाँसी का दौरा हाँफने (साँस के लिए तड़पने) के साथ शुरू होता है।
General.roman: khansi ka daura hanfne (saans ke liye tadpne) ke saath shuru hota hai.

General.en: The cough comes in fits made up of a number of individual coughs.
General.hi: खाँसी के दौरे में कुछ खास तरह की खाँसी आती है।
General.roman: Khansi ke daure mein kuch khas tarah ki khansi aati hai.

General.path: Cough, paroxysmal, consisting of few coughs
General.en: Each coughing fit consists of only a few coughs.
General.hi: खाँसी के दौरे में थोड़ी-सी (कम) खाँसियाँ आती हैं।
General.roman: Khansi ke daure mein thodi-si khansiyan aati hain.

General.path: Cough, paroxysmal, consisting of, long coughs
General.en: Each coughing fit consists of long, drawn-out coughs.
General.hi: खाँसी के दौरे में लंबी-लंबी खाँसियाँ आती हैं।
General.roman: Khansi ke daure mein lambi-lambi khansiyan aati hain.

General.path: Cough, paroxysmal, consisting of, short coughs
General.en: Each coughing fit consists of short, brief coughs.
General.hi: खाँसी के दौरे में छोटी-छोटी खाँसियाँ आती हैं।
General.roman: Khansi ke daure mein chhoti-chhoti khansiyan aati hain.

General.path: Cough, paroxysmal, consisting of, three coughs
General.en: Each coughing fit consists of exactly three coughs.
General.hi: खाँसी के दौरे में तीन बार खाँसी आती है।
General.roman: Khansi ke daure mein teen baar khansi aati hai.

General.path: Cough, paroxysmal, consisting of, two coughs
General.en: Each coughing fit consists of exactly two coughs.
General.hi: खाँसी के दौरे में दो बार खाँसी आती है।
General.roman: Khansi ke daure mein do baar khansi aati hai.

General.path: Cough, paroxysmal, consisting of, two coughs, in quick succession
General.en: Each coughing fit consists of two coughs that come one right after the other in quick succession.
General.hi: खाँसी के दौरे में दो खाँसियाँ एकदम जल्दी-जल्दी आती हैं।
General.roman: Khansi ke daure mein do khansiyan ekdum jaldi-jaldi aati hain.

General.path: Cough, paroxysmal, convulses while body in sudden paroxysms
General.en: The coughing fit is so severe it causes the whole body to convulse suddenly.
General.hi: खाँसी के दौरे इतने तेज होते हैं कि पूरा शरीर झटके खाता है।
General.roman: Khansi ke daure itne tej hote hain ki pura sharir jhatke khata hai.

General.path: Cough, paroxysmal, hard spells of coughing, not ceasing until masses of offensive sputa are raised
General.en: Severe coughing fits that will not stop until large amounts of foul-smelling phlegm are coughed up.
General.hi: खाँसी के दौरे तब तक नहीं रुकते जब तक बहुत बदबूदार बलगम (थूक) न निकल जाए।
General.roman: Khansi ke daure tab tak nahi rukte jab tak bahut badbuddar balgam (thook) na nikal jaye.

General.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks without any pause or break between them.
General.hi: खांसी का दौरा बिना रुके लगातार चलता रहता है।
General.roman: Khansi ka daura bina ruke lagatar chalta rahta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Cough, paroxysmal, bread or cake, from eating
Linked to eating/digestion.en: Eating bread or cake triggers a coughing fit.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रोटी या केक खाने से खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: roti ya cake khane se khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A coughing fit comes on after dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks in the morning but get better after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: सुबह खाना खाने से खाँसी के दौरे कम हो जाते हैं।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Subah khana khane se khansi ke daure kam ho jate hain.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A change in temperature triggers a coughing fit.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: तापमान बदलने पर खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Tapman badalne par khansi ke daure padte hain.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A coughing fit comes on after a chill (feeling of cold with shivering).
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंड लगने के बाद खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi lag ne ke baad khansi ke daure padte hain.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, paroxysmal, evening, cool wind, in
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks in the evening when stepping into cool wind.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: शाम को ठंडी हवा में खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Shaam ko thandi hava mein khansi ke daure padte hain.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, paroxysmal, night, becoming warm, in
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks at night when warming up in bed.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: रात को बिस्तर पर गर्म होते ही खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Raat ko bistar par garam hote hi khansi ke daure padte hain.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, paroxysmal, sun, walking in hot
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks while walking in hot sunshine.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: तेज धूप में चलते समय खांसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Tez dhup mein chelte samay khansi ke daure padte hain.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, paroxysmal, walking in cool wind
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks when walking in cool wind.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडी हवा में चलते समय खांसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi hawa mein chelte samay khansi ke daure padte hain.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, paroxysmal, crawling in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A coughing fit triggered by a crawling sensation in the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में रेंगने जैसी गुदगुदी से खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein rengne jaisi gudgudi se khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, paroxysmal, evening, lying down, after
Linked to posture/position.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks in the evening after lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शाम को लेटने के बाद खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Shaam ko letne ke baad khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, paroxysmal, night, midnight, before, 11 p.m. lying down, after
Linked to posture/position.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks around 11 p.m. after lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को 11 बजे लेटने के बाद खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko 11 baje letne ke baad khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, paroxysmal, night, midnight, before, on falling asleep on either side
Linked to posture/position.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks before midnight, starting as soon as you fall asleep on either side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: रात को किसी भी करवट लेटने पर नींद आते ही खाँसी के दौरे पड़ते हैं।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Raat ko kisi bhi karwat letne par neend aate hi khansi ke daure padte hain.

Linked to posture/position.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks and get better when sitting up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सीधे बैठने पर खाँसी के दौरे कम हो जाते हैं।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Seedhe baithe par khansi ke daure kam ho jate hain.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Cough, paroxysmal, followed by copious mucus
Comes with other symptoms.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks and are followed by bringing up a large amount of mucus.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: खाँसी के दौरे के बाद बहुत ज़्यादा बलगम निकलता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Khansi ke daure ke baad bahut zyada balgam nikalta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Cough, paroxysmal, night, midnight, before, swallowing mucus amel.
Comes with other symptoms.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks before midnight and are relieved by swallowing mucus.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: रात को बलगम निगलने पर खाँसी के दौरे कम हो जाते हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Raat ko balgam nigalne par khansi ke daure kam ho jate hain.

Comes with other symptoms.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks accompanied by sneezing.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: खांसी के दौरे के साथ-साथ छींकें भी आती हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Khansi ke daure ke saath-saath chhinkein bhi aati hain.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, paroxysmal, rinsing mouth with cold water, amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks and get better after rinsing the mouth with cold water.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: ठंडे पानी से कुल्ला करने पर खाँसी के दौरे कम हो जाते हैं।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Thande pani se kulla karne par khansi ke daure kam ho jate hain.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks while smoking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: धूम्रपान (बीड़ी/सिगरेट) पीते समय दौरे जैसी खांसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Dhumrapan (bidi/cigarette) pite samay daure jaisi khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, paroxysmal, stomach, lying hand on pit of, amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks and get better when placing a hand over the pit of the stomach.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पेट के ऊपरी हिस्से (छाती के नीचे) पर हाथ रखने से खांसी के दौरे में आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Pet ke uparI hisse (chhati ke neeche) par hath rakhne se khansi ke daure mein aaram milta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, paroxysmal, suffocation, suddenly on swallowing
Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing fits that come in repeated attacks that suddenly cause a feeling of choking when swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कुछ निगलते समय अचानक दम घुटने जैसा होकर खांसी का दौरा पड़ता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kuch niglte samay achanak dam ghutne jaisa hokar khansi ka daura padta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes back every other day.
Linked to time of day.hi: खांसी एक दिन छोड़कर दूसरे दिन आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Khansi ek din chodkar dusre din aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that occurs only during the daytime in a regular, recurring pattern.
Linked to time of day.hi: खांसी केवल दिन के समय आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Khansi kewal din ke samay aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, periodic, evening, sunset to sunrise
Linked to time of day.en: A cough that occurs every evening from sunset to sunrise in a regular, recurring pattern.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को सूर्यास्त के बाद से लेकर सूर्योदय तक खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko suryast ke baad se lekar suryoday tak khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that returns at regular intervals of a set number of hours.
Linked to time of day.hi: खांसी हर घंटे नियमित रूप से आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Khansi har ghante niyamit roop se aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, periodic, hour, every three hours
Linked to time of day.en: A cough that returns reliably every three hours.
Linked to time of day.hi: खांसी हर तीन घंटे पर नियमित रूप से आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Khansi har teen ghante par niyamit roop se aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, periodic, hour, same, every day
Linked to time of day.en: A cough that returns at the same hour every day.
Linked to time of day.hi: खांसी हर दिन एक ही निश्चित समय पर आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Khansi har din ek hi nischit samay par aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes back every morning in a regular, recurring pattern.
Linked to time of day.hi: खांसी सुबह के समय नियमित रूप से आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Khansi subah ke samay niyamit roop se aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes back every night in a regular, recurring pattern.
Linked to time of day.hi: खांसी रात के समय नियमित रूप से आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Khansi raat ke samay niyamit roop se aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes back every night at 2 a.m. in a regular, recurring pattern.
Linked to time of day.hi: खांसी रात के दो बजे नियमित रूप से आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Khansi raat ke do baje niyamit roop se aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes back every other night in a regular, recurring pattern.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात की खांसी एक रात छोड़कर दूसरी रात आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ki khansi ek raat chhod kar dusri raat aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes back every fourth night in a regular, recurring pattern.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात की खांसी हर चौथी रात आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ki khansi har chauthi raat aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes back every night at midnight in a regular, recurring pattern.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के समय खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke samay khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes back regularly after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के बाद खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke baad khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, periodic, night, midnight, after, every half hour
Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes back regularly after midnight, returning every half hour.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के बाद हर आधे घंटे पर खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke baad har aadhe ghante par khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, periodic, speaking or smoking, from
Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough that comes back regularly when speaking or smoking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बोलने या धूम्रपान करने से खांसी नियमित रूप से होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Bolne ya dhumrapan karne se khansi niyamit roop se hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, persistent, midnight, lying on back, agg.; lying on side, amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: A persistent cough that gets worse after midnight when lying on the back but gets better when turning onto either side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: आधी रात को पीठ के बल लेटने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है, करवट लेकर लेटने से आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Aadhi raat ko pith ke bal letne se khansi badh jati hai, karvat lekar letne se aram milta hai.

Triggered by specific situations.path: Cough, persons, approaching or passing, agg.
Triggered by specific situations.en: Coughing that gets worse when other people approach or walk past.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: किसी के पास आने या पास से गुजरने पर खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Kisi ke paas ane ya paas se gujarne par khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.path: Cough, persons, many are present, where, agg.
Triggered by specific situations.en: Coughing that gets worse when in a room with many people.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: जहाँ बहुत सारे लोग हों वहाँ जाने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Jaha bahut sare log ho vaha jane se khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.path: Cough, persons, other coming into room, agg.
Triggered by specific situations.en: Coughing that gets worse when others come into the room.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: कमरे में कोई दूसरा व्यक्ति आने पर खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Kamre mein koi dusra vyakti ane par khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing that happens while playing the piano.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पियानो बजाते समय खांसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Piano bajate samay khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, piano, when playing, every note she struck seemed to vibrate in her larynx
Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing while playing the piano, with a sensation as if every note struck seems to vibrate inside the voice box.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पियानो बजाते समय खांसी आती है और हर सुर गले (स्वरयंत्र) में कंपन करता हुआ महसूस होता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Piano bajate samay khansi aati hai aur har sur gale (swaryantr) mein kanpan karta hua mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, plug, sensation as of a, moving up and down in trachea, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Coughing caused by a feeling of a plug or blockage moving up and down in the windpipe.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: श्वास नली में ऊपर-नीचे हिलती हुई डाट जैसी चीज़ महसूस होने से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Shwas nali mein upar-neeche hilti hui daat jaisi cheez mehsus hone se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, plug, sensation of a, in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Coughing caused by a feeling of a plug or blockage stuck in the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) में डाट जैसी चीज़ फँसी महसूस होने से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale (swaryantr) mein daat jaisi cheez fansi mehsus hone se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Coughing that occurs during pregnancy.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: गर्भावस्था के दौरान खांसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Garbhavastha ke dauran khansi hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Coughing that occurs at night during pregnancy.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: गर्भावस्था के दौरान रात को खांसी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Garbhavastha ke dauran raat ko khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, pressure, chest, in
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Coughing triggered by a feeling of pressure in the chest.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: छाती में दबाव महसूस होने से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Chhati mein dabav mehsus hone se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, pressure, in stomach
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Coughing triggered by a feeling of pressure in the stomach.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पेट में दबाव महसूस होने से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pet mein dabav mehsus hone se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, pressure, on larynx
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Coughing with a feeling of pressure on the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) पर दबाव पड़ने से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale (swaryantr) par dabav padne se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, pressure, on larynx, sensation between pressure and roughness, which gradually becomes a tickling from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Coughing triggered by a feeling that starts as pressure and roughness in the voice box and gradually turns into a tickling sensation.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) में दबाव और खुरदरेपन का मिला-जुला एहसास होता है जो धीरे-धीरे गुदगुदी में बदल जाता है और खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale (swaryantr) mein dabav aur khurdurepon ka mila-jula ehsas hota hai jo dheere-dheere gudgudi mein badal jata hai aur khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, pressure, throat-pit, on
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Coughing with a feeling of pressure at the throat pit (the hollow at the base of the throat).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के गड्ढे (कंठ के नीचे का हिस्सा) पर दबाव से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ke gadhe (kanth ke neeche ka hissa) par dabav se khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing triggered by applying pressure to the voice box.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) पर दबाव पड़ने से खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Gale (swaryantr) par dabav padne se khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, pressure, on the goiter, from
Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing triggered by pressing on a goiter (a swelling at the front of the neck).
Triggered by specific actions.hi: गले की गाँठ (गॉइटर) पर दबाव पड़ने से खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Gale ki ganth (goiter) par dabav padne se khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing triggered by pressure applied to the windpipe.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: श्वास नली पर दबाव पड़ने से खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Shwas nali par dabav padne se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A violent, exhausting cough that occurs at 3 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर तीन बजे बहुत तेज़ और थकाने वाली खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar teen baje bahut tez aur thkane wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A violent, exhausting cough in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बहुत तेज़ और थकाने वाली खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko bahut tez aur thkane wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A violent, exhausting cough in the evening at 10 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को रात दस बजे बहुत तेज़ और थकाने वाली खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko raat das baje bahut tez aur thkane wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A violent, exhausting cough in the evening that continues until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को आधी रात तक बहुत तेज़ और थकाने वाली खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko aadhi raat tak bahut tez aur thkane wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A violent, exhausting cough in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय बहुत तेज़ और थकाने वाली खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay bahut tez aur thkane wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A violent, exhausting cough in the morning upon waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठते समय बहुत तेज़ और थकाने वाली खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthte samay bahut tez aur thkane wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A violent, exhausting cough at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बहुत तेज़ और थकाने वाली खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko bahut tez aur thkane wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A violent, exhausting cough at night after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात आधी रात के बाद बहुत तेज़ और थकाने वाली खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat aadhi raat ke baad bahut tez aur thkane wali khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A violent, exhausting cough triggered by taking a deep breath in.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: गहरी साँस लेने पर बहुत तेज़ और थकाने वाली खांसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Gehri sans lene par bahut tez aur thkane wali khansi aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A violent, exhausting cough that gets better after drinking water.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: पानी पीने से तेज़ और थकाने वाली खांसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Pani pine se tez aur thkane wali khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A violent, exhausting cough that gets better when sitting up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सीधे बैठने से तेज़ और थकाने वाली खांसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Sidhe baitne se tez aur thkane wali khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A rattling, bubbling cough that occurs only during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय खांसी में घर-घर या खड़-खड़ की आवाज़ आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay khansi mein ghar-ghar ya khat-khat ki aawaz aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A rattling, bubbling cough that occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को खांसी में घर-घर या खड़-खड़ की आवाज़ आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko khansi me ghar-ghar ya khard-khard ki awaaz aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A rattling, bubbling cough that occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय खांसी में घर-घर या खड़-खड़ की आवाज़ आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay khansi me ghar-ghar ya khard-khard ki awaaz aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A rattling, bubbling cough that occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खांसी में घर-घर या खड़-खड़ की आवाज़ आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko khansi me ghar-ghar ya khard-khard ki awaaz aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A rattling, bubbling cough related to eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने से खांसी में घर-घर की आवाज़ आने लगती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane se khansi mein ghar-ghar ki aawaz ane lagti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A rattling, bubbling cough that occurs after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद खांसी में घर-घर की आवाज़ आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad khansi me ghar-ghar ki awaaz aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A rattling, bubbling cough that occurs while eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते समय खांसी में घर-घर की आवाज़ आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khate samay khansi me ghar-ghar ki awaaz aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: A rattling, bubbling cough associated with hoarseness.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: खांसी के साथ घर-घर की आवाज़ और आवाज़ बैठ जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Khansi ke saath ghar-ghar ki awaaz aur awaaz baith jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: A rattling, bubbling cough with hoarseness.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: खांसी में घर-घर की आवाज़ के साथ आवाज़ बैठी हुई होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Khansi me ghar-ghar ki awaaz ke saath awaaz baithi hui hoti hai.

General.en: A rattling, bubbling cough that occurs without any hoarseness.
General.hi: खांसी में घर-घर की आवाज़ होती है लेकिन आवाज़ बैठी हुई नहीं होती।
General.roman: Khansi me ghar-ghar ki awaaz hoti hai lekin awaaz baithi hui nahi hoti.

General.en: A rattling, bubbling cough that tends to occur in elderly people.
General.hi: बुजुर्ग लोगों को खांसी में घर-घर या खड़-खड़ की आवाज़ आती है।
General.roman: Bujurg logo ko khansi me ghar-ghar ya khard-khard ki awaaz aati hai.

General.en: A rattling, bubbling cough that comes in distinct spells or bouts.
General.hi: खांसी घर-घर की आवाज़ के दौरों में आती है।
General.roman: Khansi ghar-ghar ki awaaz ke dauro me aati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A rattling, bubbling cough that gets better in the open air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने से घर-घर की आवाज़ वाली खांसी में आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Khuli hawa me jane se ghar-ghar ki awaaz wali khansi me aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, rattling, wheezing or whistling with cough, while lying on back, or on either side
Linked to posture/position.en: A rattling or wheezing cough that occurs while lying on the back or on either side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ के बल या किसी भी करवट लेटने पर खांसी में घर-घर-सीटी जैसी आवाज़ आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Pith ke bal ya kisi bhi karvat letne par khansi me ghar-ghar-siti jaisi awaaz aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing that gets worse when reading aloud.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: जोर से पढ़ने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Jor se padhne se khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing brought on by reading aloud in the evening.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: शाम को जोर से पढ़ने से खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sham ko jor se padhne se khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The cough gets better when getting up and rising.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: उठने से खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Uthne se khansi kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The cough comes on when getting out of bed in the morning.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बिस्तर से उठते समय खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Bistar se uthte samay khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The cough occurs just before getting up.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: उठने से पहले खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Uthne se pehle khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The cough gets worse when getting up or rising.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: उठने पर खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Uthne par khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The cough comes on when rising up from a stooped or bent-over position.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: झुककर उठने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Jhukkar uthne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough feels rough or harsh and is worse at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खुरदरी और कर्कश खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko khurdhri aur karkash khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough feels rough or harsh and is worse around midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के समय खुरदरी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke samay khurdhri khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, salt food, and pepper in larynx, as if from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The cough is triggered by a sensation in the voice box as if salt and pepper were there.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले की नली में नमक और काली मिर्च जैसी जलन महसूस होने से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ki nali mein namak aur kali mirch jaisi jalan mehsus hone se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, scraping, chest
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The cough causes a scraping sensation in the chest.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: खांसी में छाती में खुरचने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: khansi mein chhati mein khurchne jaisa mehsoos hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, scraping, chest, in
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The cough is triggered by a scraping feeling inside the chest.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: खांसते समय छाती के अंदर खुरचने जैसा लगता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: khante samay chhati ke andar khurchne jaisa lagta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, scraping, chest, upper, in
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The cough is triggered by a scraping feeling in the upper part of the chest.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: खांसते समय छाती के ऊपरी हिस्से में खुरचने जैसा लगता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: khante samay chhati ke upri hisse mein khurchne jaisa lagta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, scraping, fauces
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The cough is triggered by a scraping feeling at the back of the throat (where the throat meets the mouth).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के पिछले हिस्से (फॉसेज़) में खुरचन महसूस होने से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: gale ke pichle hisse (fossez) mein khurchan mehsoos hone se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, scraping, larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The cough is triggered by a scraping feeling in the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले की नली (स्वरयंत्र) में खुरचन से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: gale ki nali (swaryantri) mein khurchan se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, scraping, pharynx, in
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The cough is triggered by a scraping feeling in the back of the throat.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के पिछले हिस्से (ग्रसनी) में खुरचन से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: gale ke pichle hisse (grasnee) mein khurchan se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, scraping, trachea, in, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The cough is triggered by a scraping feeling in the windpipe.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: श्वासनली में खुरचन महसूस होने से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: shwashnali mein khurchan mehsoos hone se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough has a scraping quality and is worse in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को खांसी होती है जिसमें खुरचने जैसी अनुभूति होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: shaam ko khansi hoti hai jisme khurchne jaisi anubhuti hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, scraping, evening, lying down, after
Linked to time of day.en: The cough has a scraping quality and comes on in the evening after lying down.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को लेटने के बाद खुरचने जैसी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: shaam ko letne ke baad khurchne jaisi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough has a scraping quality and is worse at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खुरचने जैसी अनुभूति के साथ खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: rat ko khurchne jaisi anubhuti ke saath khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough has a scraping quality at night and comes on when waking up.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को नींद खुलने पर खुरचने जैसी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: rat ko nind khulne par khurchne jaisi khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, scratching, larynx, in
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The cough is triggered by a scratching feeling in the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले की नली (स्वरयंत्र) में खरोंच जैसी अनुभूति से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: gale ki nali (swaryantri) mein kharaunsch jaisi anubhuti se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, scratching, trachea, in, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The cough is triggered by a scratching feeling in the windpipe.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: श्वासनली में खरोंच जैसी अनुभूति से खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: shwashnali mein kharaunsch jaisi anubhuti se khansi hoti hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The cough comes in repeated series or bouts one after another.
Sounds & movement.hi: खांसी झटकों में लगातार आती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: khansi jhatko mein lagatar aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, series, in, 10 a.m. to 11 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: The cough comes in repeated series between 10 a.m. and 11 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह दस बजे से ग्यारह बजे के बीच खांसी झटकों में लगातार आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah das baje se gyarah baje ke beech khansi jhatko mein lagatar aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The cough becomes sharp after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद तेज़ चुभने वाली खांसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad tez chubhne wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and comes on after an afternoon nap.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर की झपकी के बाद छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ki jhapki ke baad chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs at 2 p.m. in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद दो बजे छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad do baje chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs at 5 p.m. in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम पाँच बजे छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam paanch baje chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs only during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs both during the day and at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन में भी और रात में भी छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din mein bhi aur raat mein bhi chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs in the evening while in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बिस्तर पर लेटने के बाद छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko bistar par letne ke baad chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and happens while sleeping in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को नींद के दौरान छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko nind ke dauran chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The short cough gets worse from smoking in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को धूम्रपान करने से छोटी-छोटी खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko dhumrapan karne se chhoti-chhoti khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and comes on in the evening when getting undressed.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को कपड़े उतारते समय छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko kapde utarte samay chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs in the late morning (forenoon).
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय (दोपहर से पहले) छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay dopahar se pehle chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs at 11 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह ग्यारह बजे छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah gyarah baje chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने पर छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah uthne par chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief in the morning after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने के बाद छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah uthne ke baad chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and comes on in the morning on waking up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलने पर छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah nind khulne par chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: rat ko chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs at night while in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बिस्तर में लेटने पर छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: rat ko bistar mein letne par chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs around midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के समय छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: rat ko aadhi rat ke samay chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के बाद छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: rat ko aadhi rat ke baad chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs before midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात से पहले छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: rat ko aadhi rat se pehle chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, short, night, midnight, before, 11 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: The cough is short and brief and occurs before midnight, around 11 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को ग्यारह बजे (आधी रात से पहले) छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: rat ko gyarah baje (aadhi rat se pehle) chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, short, night, midnight, before, wakens
Linked to time of day.en: The short brief cough before midnight wakes the person from sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात से पहले खांसी आकर नींद टूट जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: rat ko aadhi rat se pehle khansi aakar nind tut jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: The short cough gets worse in the open air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने से छोटी-छोटी खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Khuli hawa mein jane se chhoti-chhoti khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The cough is short and brief and brought on by taking a deep breath.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: गहरी साँस लेने पर छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Gahri sans lene par chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The short cough gets worse when breathing in.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: साँस अंदर खींचने पर छोटी-छोटी खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: sans andar khinchne par chhoti-chhoti khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The short cough comes on when moving around.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हिलने-डुलने पर छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: hilne-dulne par chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The short cough comes on or gets worse when smoking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: धूम्रपान करते समय छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: dhumrapan karte samay chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The short cough is triggered by swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कुछ निगलने पर छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: kuch nigalne par chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The short cough comes on while talking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बात करते समय छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: baat karte samay chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The short cough gets worse when walking fast.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: तेज़ चलने पर छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Tez chalne par chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, short, walking, open air, in
Triggered by specific actions.en: The short cough gets worse when walking in the open air.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खुली हवा में चलते समय छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khuli hawa mein chlete samay chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Sounds & movement.path: Cough, short, deep cough, alternating with
Sounds & movement.en: The cough alternates between being short and brief and being deep.
Sounds & movement.hi: छोटी-छोटी खांसी और गहरी खांसी बारी-बारी से होती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Chhoti-chhoti khansi aur gahri khansi bari-bari se hoti hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The cough is short, brief, and happens very frequently.
Sounds & movement.hi: बार-बार छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती रहती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: baar-baar chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti rahti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The cough is short and brief and comes on after dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात के खाने के बाद छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Raat ke khane ke baad chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The cough is short and brief and comes on after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: कुछ भी खाने के बाद छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Kuch bhi khane ke baad chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The cough is short and brief and comes on after eating and lying down.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाने के बाद लेटने पर छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: khane ke baad letne par chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Cough, short, morning, tea drinking, after
Linked to eating/digestion.en: The cough is short and brief in the morning after drinking tea.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: सुबह चाय पीने के बाद छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: subah chai pine ke baad chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, short, irritation in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The short cough is triggered by an irritation in the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले की नली (स्वरयंत्र) में खुजली होने से छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: gale ki nali (swaryantr) mein khujli hone se chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, short, tickling in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The short cough is triggered by a tickling feeling in the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले की नली (स्वरयंत्र) में गुदगुदी होने से छोटी-छोटी खांसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ki nali (swaryantra) mein gudgudi hone se chhoti-chhoti khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The short cough gets better when sitting up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सीधे बैठने पर छोटी-छोटी खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: sidhe baithne par chhoti-chhoti khansi kam ho jati hai.

Sounds & movement.en: The cough is high-pitched and shrill and comes on when waking up.
Sounds & movement.hi: नींद खुलने पर तीखी ऊँची आवाज़ में खांसी होती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Nind khulne par tikhi unchi awaaz mein khansi hoti hai.

Sounds & movement.path: Cough, sibilant, and dry, like a saw driven through a pine board
Sounds & movement.en: The cough is dry, wheezing, and sounds like a saw cutting through a pine board.
Sounds & movement.hi: खांसी में आरी से लकड़ी चीरने जैसी सरसराती सूखी आवाज़ आती है।
Sounds & movement.roman: Khansi mein ari se lakdi chirane jaisi sarsarati sukhi awaaz aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The cough forces the person to sit up in order to cough.
Linked to posture/position.hi: खाँसी में राहत के लिए उठकर बैठना ज़रूरी हो जाता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Khansi mein aahat ke liye uthkar baithna zaruri ho jata hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, sit up, must, and cough it out, when had rest
Linked to posture/position.en: After resting, the person must sit up and cough to clear things out.
Linked to posture/position.hi: आराम करने के बाद जब खाँसी आती है तो उठकर बैठना पड़ता है और खाँसकर बलगम निकालना पड़ता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Aaram karne ke baad jab khansi aati hai to uthkar baithna padta hai aur khanskar balgam nikalna padta hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, sit up, must, as soon as cough begins
Linked to posture/position.en: As soon as the cough starts, the person must sit up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: जैसे ही खाँसी शुरू होती है, तुरंत उठकर बैठना पड़ता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Jaise hi khansi shuru hoti hai, turant uthkar baithna padta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The cough gets worse when sitting in a bent-forward position.
Linked to posture/position.hi: झुककर बैठने से खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Jhukkar baithe rehne se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The cough gets better when sitting in a bent-forward position.
Linked to posture/position.hi: झुककर बैठने से खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Jhukkar baithe rehne se khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The cough gets worse when sitting up straight.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सीधे बैठने से खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Sidhe baithe rehne se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The cough gets better when sitting up straight.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सीधे बैठने से खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Sidhe baithe rehne se khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The cough gets worse after sitting for a long time.
Linked to posture/position.hi: देर तक बैठे रहने से खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Der tak baithe rehne se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The cough comes on while sitting quietly still.
Linked to posture/position.hi: चुपचाप बैठे रहने पर खाँसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Cupchap baithe rehne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The cough comes on while sitting quietly still in the afternoon.
Linked to posture/position.hi: दोपहर बाद चुपचाप बैठे रहने पर खाँसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: dopahar baad cupchap baithe rahne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The cough gets better when sitting quietly still.
Linked to posture/position.hi: चुपचाप बैठे रहने से खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: cupchap baithe rahne se khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The cough gets worse while sitting quietly still.
Linked to posture/position.hi: चुपचाप बैठे रहने पर खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: cupchap baithe rahne par khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The cough comes on while sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठे रहने के दौरान खाँसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: baithe rahne ke dauran khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough comes on after waking from sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद के बाद खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: nind ke baad khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough comes on before falling asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद आने से पहले खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: nind aane se pehle khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough disturbs or breaks up sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: खाँसी नींद में खलल डालती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: khansi nind mein khalal dalti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough occurs during sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद के दौरान खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: nind ke dauran khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough comes on when first going to sleep or drifting off.
Linked to time of day.hi: सोने जाते समय खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: sone jate samay khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough comes on when going to sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: सोने जाते समय खाँसी शुरू हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: sone jate samay khansi shuru ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, sleep, going to, on, one hour after
Linked to time of day.en: The cough comes on about one hour after going to sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: सोने जाने के एक घंटे बाद खाँसी शुरू होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: sone jane ke ek ghante baad khansi shuru hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough keeps the person from falling asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: खाँसी की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: khansi ki wajah se nind nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough starts just as the person is beginning to fall asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद लगते ही खाँसी शुरू हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: nind lagte hi khansi shuru ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough wakes the person from sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: खाँसी से नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: khansi se nind khul jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Cough, sleep, falls asleep during dry cough
Comes with other symptoms.en: The person falls asleep despite having a dry cough.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: सूखी खाँसी आती रहती है और इसी दौरान नींद आ जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: sukhi khansi aati rahti hai aur isi dauran nind aa jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, sleep, going to, on, lying on side, when
Linked to posture/position.en: The cough comes on when lying on one side while going to sleep.
Linked to posture/position.hi: करवट लेकर लेटने पर सोते वक्त खाँसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: karvat lekar letne par sote wakt khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, smoking agg., dinner, after, on
Triggered by specific actions.en: Smoking after dinner makes the cough worse.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: रात के खाने के बाद धूम्रपान करने से खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: raat ke khane ke baad dhoomrapan karne se khansi badh jati hai

Triggered by specific actions.en: Smoking in the evening makes the cough worse.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: शाम को धूम्रपान करने से खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: sham ko dhoomrapan karne se khansi badh jati hai

Triggered by specific actions.en: The cough gets better at night when smoking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: रात में धूम्रपान करने से खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: raat mein dhoomrapan karne se khansi mein aaram milta hai

Triggered by specific actions.en: Sneezing brings relief from the cough.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: छींकने से खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: chinkne se khansi mein aaram milta hai

Triggered by specific actions.en: Sneezing makes the cough worse.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: छींकने से खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: chinkne se khansi badh jati hai

General.en: The cough ends in a sneeze.
General.hi: खाँसी छींक के साथ खत्म होती है।
General.roman: khansi chink ke saath khatm hoti hai

Comes with other symptoms.en: The cough comes with sneezing at the same time.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: खाँसी के साथ-साथ छींक भी आती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: khansi ke saath-saath chink bhi aati hai

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: dopahar baad khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein ati hai

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: din ke samay khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein ati hai

Linked to time of day.en: The daytime brings relief from spasmodic coughing fits.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय ऐसी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay aisi khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits are made worse only during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन में ही खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में बढ़ती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din mein hi khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein badhti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur in the evening and continue until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम से आधी रात तक खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam se aadhi raat tak khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits last from the evening until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम से आधी रात तक ऐसी खाँसी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam se aadhi raat tak aisi khansi rehti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, spasmodic, evening, midnight, until, after
Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur from evening and continue after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम से आधी रात के बाद तक ऐसी खाँसी रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam se aadhi raat ke baad tak aisi khansi rehti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur in the late morning (before noon).
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह दस बजे से दोपहर तक खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah das baje se dopahar tak khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur in the morning while still in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बिस्तर पर रहते हुए खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah bistar par rahte hue khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur in the morning after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने के बाद खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne ke baad khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur in the morning on waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलने पर खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind khulne par khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur at midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात को खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ko khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ke baad khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, spasmodic, night, midnight, afternoon, until
Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur at night until the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात तक दोपहर से खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat tak dopahar se khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur before midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, spasmodic, night, midnight, before, 10-30 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur before midnight, between 10:00 and 10:30 in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात दस से साढ़े दस बजे के बीच खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat das se saadhe das baje ke beech khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, spasmodic, night, sunset to sunrise
Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur at night from sunset to sunrise.
Linked to time of day.hi: सूर्यास्त से सूर्योदय तक रात भर खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Suryast se suryoday tak raat bhar khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur at night on waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को नींद खुलने पर खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko neend khulne par khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur from noon through until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर से आधी रात तक खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar se aadhi raat tak khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Spasmodic coughing fits come on upon waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद खुलने पर खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Neend khulne par khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur in autumn.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: पतझड़ (शरद ऋतु) में खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: patjhad sharad ritu mein khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein ati hai

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A change in temperature triggers spasmodic coughing fits.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: तापमान बदलने पर खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आने लगती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: tapmaan badalne par khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein ane lagti hai

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Summer heat brings relief from spasmodic coughing fits.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्मी के मौसम की गर्मी से ऐसी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garmi ke mausam ki garmi se aisi khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur in winter.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: सर्दियों में ऐंठन वाली खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Sardiyon mein ainthan wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Cold drinks bring relief from spasmodic coughing fits.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: ठंडा पानी पीने से ऐसी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: thanda pani pine se aisi khansi mein aaram milta hai

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Spasmodic coughing fits come on after drinking.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: पीने के बाद खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Pine ke baad khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Spasmodic coughing fits occur while eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते समय खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khate samay khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Spasmodic coughing fits come on after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Eating brings relief from spasmodic coughing fits.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने से ऐसी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane se aisi khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Eating in the morning brings relief from spasmodic coughing fits.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: सुबह खाना खाने से ऐसी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Subah khana khane se aisi khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Swallowing liquids makes spasmodic coughing fits worse.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: कोई तरल पदार्थ निगलने पर ऐसी खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Koi taral padarth nigalne par aisi khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Taking a deep breath in brings relief from spasmodic coughing fits.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: गहरी साँस लेने से ऐसी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Gahri sans lene se aisi khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Smoking makes spasmodic coughing fits worse.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: धूम्रपान (बीड़ी/सिगरेट) पीने से ऐसी खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Dhumrpan (bidi/cigarette) pine se aisi khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Smoking brings relief from spasmodic coughing fits.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: धूम्रपान करने से ऐसी खाँसी में आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Dhumrpan karne se aisi khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Spasmodic coughing fits come on after talking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बात करने के बाद खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Baat karne ke baad khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: Spasmodic coughing fits come with difficulty breathing.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ऐसी खाँसी के साथ साँस लेने में तकलीफ़ होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Aisi khansi ke saath sans lene mein taklif hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: Spasmodic coughing fits come with vomiting.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ऐसी खाँसी के साथ उल्टी भी होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Aisi khansi ke saath ulti bhi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: Lying down makes spasmodic coughing fits worse.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने पर खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne par khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein badh jati hai.

General.en: Spasmodic coughing fits are particularly a problem in elderly people.
General.hi: बुज़ुर्ग लोगों को खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती है।
General.roman: Buzurg logon ko khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein aati hai.

General.en: Spasmodic coughing fits continue after having whooping cough.
General.hi: काली खाँसी (कुकुर खाँसी) ठीक होने के बाद भी खाँसी अचानक तेज़ झटकों में आती रहती है।
General.roman: Kali khansi (kukur khansi) theek hone ke baad bhi khansi achanak tez jhatkon mein ati rahti hai.

General.en: Spasmodic coughing fits that are particularly a problem in women.
General.hi: महिलाओं को खास तौर पर ऐंठन वाली खाँसी होती है।
General.roman: Mahilaon ko khas taur par ainthan wali khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A splitting or tearing cough that occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खाँसी इतनी तेज़ होती है कि सिर फटने जैसा लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko khansi itni tez hoti hai ki sir fatne jaisa lagta hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough that occurs in spring.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: वसंत के मौसम में खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Vasant ke mausam mein khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, spring, in the, and autumn
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough that occurs in both spring and autumn.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: वसंत और पतझड़ दोनों मौसमों में खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Vasant aur patjhad donon mausamon mein khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: Standing makes the cough worse.
Linked to posture/position.hi: खड़े रहने पर खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Khde rahne par khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: Standing brings relief from the cough.
Linked to posture/position.hi: खड़े रहने पर खाँसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Khde rahne par khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: Standing upright triggers a cough.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सीधे खड़े रहने पर खाँसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Seedhe khde rahne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, standing, sitting, after, and vice versa
Linked to posture/position.en: The cough is triggered by changing between standing and sitting, or sitting and standing.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठने के बाद खड़े होने पर या खड़े रहने के बाद बैठने पर खाँसी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Baithe ke baad khde hone par ya khde rahne ke baad baithe par khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, standing, still, during a walk
Triggered by specific actions.en: The cough comes on when stopping still during a walk.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: चलते-चलते एक जगह रुककर खड़े होने पर खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Chalte-chalte ek jagah rukar khde hone par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The cough has a loud, rattling, snoring-like sound and occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खाँसी के साथ घरघराहट की आवाज़ आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko khansi ke saath ghargarahat ki awaz ati hai.

Specific body area.en: A sharp, stabbing cough felt in the chest.
Specific body area.hi: खाँसते वक्त छाती में चुभन जैसा दर्द होता है।
Specific body area.roman: Khaste waqt chhati mein chuban jaisa dard hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, sticking, in larynx
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sharp, stabbing sensation in the voice box that causes coughing.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) में चुभन की वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale (svar yantra) mein chuban ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, sticking, in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough triggered by a sharp, stabbing feeling in the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) में चुभन की वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale (svaryantr) mein chuban ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, sticking, in larynx, from, 1 a.m. to 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: A cough triggered by a sharp, stabbing feeling in the voice box, occurring between 1 a.m. and 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 1 बजे से 4 बजे के बीच गले (स्वरयंत्र) में चुभन की वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat 1 baje se 4 baje ke beech gale (svaryantr) mein chuban ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Specific body area.en: A sharp, stitching pain in the chest brought on by coughing.
Specific body area.hi: खाँसते वक्त छाती में सुई चुभने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Specific body area.roman: Khante vakt chhati mein sui chubne jaisa dard hota hai.

Specific body area.en: A sharp, stitching pain in the upper-middle belly brought on by coughing.
Specific body area.hi: खाँसते वक्त पेट के ऊपरी हिस्से में सुई चुभने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Specific body area.roman: Khante vakt pet ke upri hisse mein sui chubne jaisa dard hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, stitching, in larynx
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A sharp, stitching pain in the voice box that causes coughing.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) में सुई चुभने जैसी तकलीफ की वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale (svaryantr) mein sui chubne jaisi taklif ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, stitching, in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough triggered by a sharp, stitching sensation in the voice box.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले (स्वरयंत्र) में सुई चुभने से खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale (svaryantr) mein sui chubne se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, stitching, in trachea, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough triggered by a sharp, stitching sensation in the windpipe.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: साँस की नली (श्वासनली) में सुई चुभने जैसी तकलीफ की वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Sans ki nali (shvasnali) mein sui chubne jaisi taklif ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, stitching, in larynx, from, evening
Linked to time of day.en: A cough triggered by a sharp, stitching sensation in the voice box in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को गले (स्वरयंत्र) में सुई चुभने जैसी तकलीफ से खाँसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko gale (svaryantr) mein sui chubne jaisi taklif se khansi hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, stomach, seems to come from the
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough that feels as though it comes from the stomach.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे खाँसी पेट से आ रही हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise khansi pet se aa rahi ho.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, stomach, turned inside out, feeling as if
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough that produces the feeling that the stomach is being turned inside out.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: खाँसते वक्त ऐसा लगता है जैसे पेट उलट-पुलट हो रहा हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Khante vakt aisa lagta hai jaise pet ulat-pulat ho raha ho.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough that comes on before a storm.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: तूफ़ान आने से पहले खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Toofan ane se pehle khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough that comes on before a thunderstorm.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: बिजली-कड़क वाला तूफ़ान आने से पहले खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Bijli-kadak vala toofan ane se pehle khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on suddenly during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन में अचानक खाँसी आ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din mein achaanak khansi aa jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on suddenly in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को अचानक खाँसी आ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko achaanak khansi aa jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on suddenly in the evening while sitting.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बैठे-बैठे अचानक खाँसी आ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko baithe-baithe achaanak khansi aa jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on suddenly in the late morning (before noon).
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर से पहले (सुबह के वक्त) अचानक खाँसी आ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar se pehle (subah ke waqt) achaanak khansi aa jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on suddenly in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह अचानक खाँसी आ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah achaanak khansi aa jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on suddenly in the morning on getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठते ही अचानक खाँसी आ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthte hi achaanak khansi aa jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on suddenly at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को अचानक खाँसी आ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko achaanak khansi aa jati hai.

General.path: Cough, suffocative, child becomes stiff and blue in face
General.en: During a suffocative coughing fit, the child goes stiff and the face turns blue.
General.hi: खाँसते-खाँसते बच्चा अकड़ जाता है और चेहरा नीला पड़ जाता है।
General.roman: Khanstte-khanstte bachchha akad jata hai aur chehra nila pad jata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A suffocating, choking cough that occurs during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन में साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din mein sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A suffocating, choking cough that occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A suffocating, choking cough that occurs in the evening at 6 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 6 बजे साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 6 baje sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on in the evening at 7 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 7 बजे साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 7 baje sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on when you are in bed in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बिस्तर पर जाते ही साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko bistar par jate hi sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.
