Linked to time of day.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on in the morning at 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 5 बजे साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah 5 baje sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on in the morning after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने के बाद साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: subah uthne ke baad sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat ko sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, suffocative, night, 2 a.m. and 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on at night at 2 a.m. and again at 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 2 बजे और 4 बजे साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat 2 baje aur 4 baje sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on at night at 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 5 बजे साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: raat 5 baje sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on at midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात को साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: aadhi raat ko sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: aadhi raat ke baad sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on at noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर के समय साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: dopahar ke samay sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A choking, suffocating cough that occurs while you are asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद के दौरान साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: nind ke dauran sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Cough, suffocative, eating and drinking, after
Linked to eating/digestion.en: A suffocating, choking cough that comes on after eating or drinking.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाने-पीने के बाद साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khane-pine ke baad sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A choking, suffocating cough that is triggered by breathing in.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: साँस लेने पर साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sans lene par sans ghutne jaisi khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A choking, suffocating cough that is triggered by swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कुछ निगलने पर साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: kuch niglne par sans ghutne jaisi khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on while walking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: चलने पर साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: chalne par sans ghutne jaisi khansi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on while you are lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटे रहने पर साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: lete rehne par sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, suffocative, morning, lying down, while
Linked to posture/position.en: A choking, suffocating cough that comes on in the morning while lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सुबह लेटे-लेटे साँस घुटने जैसी खाँसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: subah lete-lete sans ghutne jaisi khansi aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough that gets worse after eating sugar.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: चीनी या मीठी चीज़ खाने से खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: chini ya mithi chiz khane se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough that gets better after eating sugar.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: चीनी या मीठी चीज़ खाने से खाँसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: chini ya mithi chiz khane se khansi kam ho jati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, sugar, dissolving in larynx, as if was
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough triggered by a sensation as if sugar were dissolving in your throat (voice box area).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे गले (स्वरयंत्र) में चीनी घुल रही हो और इसकी वजह से खाँसी होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: aisa lagta hai jaise gale (svaryantr) mein chini ghul rahi ho aur iski wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough that comes on after eating supper.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात का खाना खाने के बाद खाँसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Raat ka khana khane ke baad khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A cough that comes on during supper.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात का खाना खाते समय खाँसी होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Raat ka khana khate samay khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough that gets worse when you swallow.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कुछ निगलने पर खाँसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kuch nigalne par khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough that gets better when you swallow.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कुछ निगलने पर खाँसी कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kuch nigalne par khansi kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough that gets worse when you swallow saliva or do a dry swallow.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाली निगलने (बिना कुछ खाए-पिए निगलने) से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khali nigalne se khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough that gets better when you do a dry swallow.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाली निगलने (बिना कुछ खाए-पिए निगलने) से खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khali nigalne se khansi kam ho jati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, swollen, feeling in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a feeling of swelling in the voice box (throat area).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के ढक्कन (स्वर यंत्र) में सूजन जैसा महसूस होने से खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ke dhakkan mein sujan jaisa mehsoos hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, swollen, larynx, from
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough caused by swelling of the voice box (throat area).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले के ढक्कन (स्वर यंत्र) में सूजन होने की वजह से खांसी आती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale ke dhakkan mein sujan hone ki wajah se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough at night that seems to come in sympathy with a problem elsewhere in the body.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को किसी और तकलीफ की वजह से सहानुभूति में खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko kisi aur taklif ki wajah se sahanubbhuti mein khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on when you talk in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बात करने पर खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko baat karne par khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough that comes on when you talk at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बात करने पर खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko baat karne par khansi aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Cough, talking, inability to speak, with
Comes with other symptoms.en: A cough that comes on when you talk and leaves you unable to speak.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बात करने पर खांसी आती है और साथ में बोल भी नहीं पाते।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Baat karne par khansi aati hai aur saath mein bol bhi nahi paate.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough that comes on when you talk loudly.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: ऊंची आवाज में बात करने पर खांसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Unchhi awaz mein baat karne par khansi aati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: A tearing cough that comes on during the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान चीरने-फाड़ने जैसी तेज खांसी आती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran chirane-farne jaisi tez khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tearing cough that comes on at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को चीरने-फाड़ने जैसी तेज खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Rat ko chirane-farne jaisi tez khansi aati hai.

Type of pain.en: A cough with a tearing sensation felt in the area of the heart (left-centre chest).
Type of pain.hi: खांसी आने पर दिल के आसपास के हिस्से में चीरने जैसा दर्द महसूस होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Khansi aane par dil ke aaspass ke hisse mein chirane jaisa dard mehsus hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation in the back of the throat at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को गले के पिछले हिस्से (ग्रसनी) में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Rat ko gale ke pichle hisse (grasnee) mein gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that comes on in the afternoon at 3 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद 3 बजे गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad 3 baje gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that occurs only during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din mein gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that occurs both during the day and at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन और रात दोनों समय गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din aur raat donon samay gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that comes on in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, tickling, evening, 6 p.m., expectoration of mucus, amel.
Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that comes on in the evening around 6 p.m. and gets better after coughing up mucus.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को 6 बजे गुदगुदी से खांसी आती है और बलगम निकलने पर आराम मिलता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko 6 baje gudgudi se khansi aati hai aur balgam nikalne par aaram milta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that comes on in the evening when you are in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बिस्तर पर लेटने पर गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko bistar par letne par gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, tickling, evening, falling asleep, before
Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that comes on in the evening just before you fall asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को नींद आने से पहले गुदगुदी होकर खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko nind aane se pehle gudgudi hokar khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, tickling, evening, going to sleep, on
Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that comes on in the evening as you are falling asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को सोने लगते ही गुदगुदी होकर खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko sone lagte hi gudgudi hokar khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that comes on in the evening and continues until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम से आधी रात तक गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam se aadhi raat tak gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in, from, afternoon
Linked to time of day.en: A tickling-in-the-voice-box cough that comes on in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद गले के ढक्कन में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad gale ke dhakkan me gudgudi hone se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in, from, afternoon, 2 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: A tickling-in-the-voice-box cough that comes on in the afternoon at 2 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद 2 बजे गले के ढक्कन में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad 2 baje gale ke dhakkan me gudgudi hone se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in, from, evening
Linked to time of day.en: A tickling-in-the-voice-box cough that comes on in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को गले के ढक्कन में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko gale ke dhakkan me gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in, from, morning, rising, after
Linked to time of day.en: A tickling-in-the-voice-box cough that comes on in the morning after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने के बाद गले के ढक्कन में गुदगुदी होकर खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah utne ke baad gale ke dhakkan me gudgudi hokar khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in, from, night
Linked to time of day.en: A tickling-in-the-voice-box cough that comes on at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को गले के ढक्कन में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko gale ke dhakkan mein gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in, from, night, 11-30 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: A tickling-in-the-voice-box cough that comes on at night around 11:30 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को साढ़े ग्यारह बजे गले के ढक्कन में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko saadhe gyarah baje gale ke dhakkan mein gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in, from, night, 3 a.m. to 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: A tickling-in-the-voice-box cough that comes on at night between 3 a.m. and 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 3 बजे से 4 बजे के बीच गले के ढक्कन में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat 3 baje se 4 baje ke beech gale ke dhakkan mein gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that comes on in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय गुदगुदी होकर खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay gudgudi hokar khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that comes on in the morning after getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने के बाद गुदगुदी होकर खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne ke baad gudgudi hokar khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that comes on in the morning after walking.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह चलने के बाद गुदगुदी होकर खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah chalne ke baad gudgudi hokar khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that comes on at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that comes on at night at 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 3 बजे गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat 3 baje gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tickling cough that comes on when you wake up.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद खुलने पर गुदगुदी होकर खांसी आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Nind khulne par gudgudi hokar khansi aati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A tickling cough that comes on in the open air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने से गुदगुदी होकर खांसी आती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Khuli hawa mein jane se gudgudi hokar khansi aati hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, tickling, bronchia
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation in the airways (bronchial tubes).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: सांस की नलियों (ब्रोंकाई) में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Sans ki naliyon (bronkai) mein gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, tickling, bronchia, bifurcation
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation at the point where the airways (bronchial tubes) split in two.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: सांस की नलियों के बंटने वाली जगह पर गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Sans ki naliyon ke bantne wali jagah par gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, tickling, larynx
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation in the voice box area.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले के ढक्कन (स्वर यंत्र) में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale ke dhakkan (svar yantr) me gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation coming from the voice box area.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले के ढक्कन (स्वर यंत्र) में गुदगुदी होने की वजह से खांसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale ke dhakkan (svar yantr) me gudgudi hone ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in, from
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough triggered by a tickling sensation arising from the voice box area.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले के ढक्कन में गुदगुदी की वजह से खांसी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale ke dhakkan me gudgudi ki wajah se khansi hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in, from, small spot in, agg.
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough made worse by a small, specific irritated spot in the voice box area.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले के ढक्कन में एक छोटी सी जगह पर गुदगुदी होने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale ke dhakkan mein ek chhoti si jagah par gudgudi hone se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to a specific organ.path: Cough, tickling, trachea, in, from
Linked to a specific organ.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation in the windpipe.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: सांस की मुख्य नली (ट्रेकिया) में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Sans ki mukhya nali (trachea) mein gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tickling, chest
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation in the chest.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: सीने में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Sine mein gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tickling, chest, upper, in
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation in the upper chest.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: सीने के ऊपरी हिस्से में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Sine ke upari hisse mein gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tickling, epigastrium, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation felt in the upper-middle belly area.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: पेट के ऊपरी हिस्से में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Pet ke uparी hisse me gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tickling, fauces
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation at the back of the throat (where the throat meets the nose).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के पीछे ऊपरी हिस्से (फॉसेज) में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ke piche uparī hisse (fossez) me gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in, from, down, as from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough triggered by a tickling in the voice box that feels as if it is coming from deep down.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के ढक्कन में नीचे की तरफ गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ke dhakkan me niche ki taraf gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in, from, extending to chest
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A tickling sensation in the voice box that triggers a cough and spreads down into the chest.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के ढक्कन में गुदगुदी होती है और वह सीने तक फैलती है जिससे खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ke dhakkan me gudgudi hoti hai aur wah sine tak failti hai jisse khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in, from, extending, to midsternum
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A tickling sensation in the voice box that triggers a cough and spreads down to the middle of the breastbone.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के ढक्कन में गुदगुदी होती है जो सीने के बीच तक फैलती है और खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ke dhakkan me gudgudi hoti hai jo sine ke beech tak failti hai aur khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tickling, pharynx, in
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation in the back of the throat (pharynx).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के पिछले हिस्से में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ke pichle hisse mein gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tickling, precordial region
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation in the area over the heart (left-centre chest).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: दिल के सामने वाले हिस्से में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Dil ke samne wale hisse mein gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tickling, throat-pit, in, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation at the pit of the throat (the hollow at the base of the neck).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के गड्ढे (गले की जड़) में गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ke gadhe (gale ki jad) mein gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tickling, tonsils, below
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough caused by a tickling sensation just below the tonsils.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: टॉन्सिल के नीचे गुदगुदी होने से खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Tonsil ke neeche gudgudi hone se khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, tickling, larynx, in, from, lying, while
Linked to posture/position.en: A tickling-in-the-voice-box cough that comes on while lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटे रहने पर गले के ढक्कन में गुदगुदी होकर खांसी आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Lete rehne par gale ke dhakkan me gudgudi hokar khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A tickling cough that is triggered by smoking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: धूम्रपान (बीड़ी/सिगरेट) पीने से गुदगुदी होकर खांसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Dhumrapan (beedi/cigarette) pine se gudgudi hokar khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A tickling cough that comes on when you talk.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बात करने पर गुदगुदी होकर खांसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Baat karne par gudgudi hokar khansi aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tight, constricted cough that occurs only during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन में खांसी जकड़ी हुई और रुकी हुई सी लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din mein khansi jakdi hui aur ruki hui si lagti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A tight, constricted cough that comes on in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को खांसी जकड़ी हुई और रुकी हुई सी लगती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko khansi jakdi hui aur ruki hui si lagti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tingling, chest
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough accompanied by a tingling sensation in the chest.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: खांसी के साथ सीने में झनझनाहट महसूस होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: khansi ke saath sine mein jhanjhanahat mehsus hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tingling, larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough triggered by a tingling sensation in the voice box area.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले के ढक्कन में झनझनाहट होने से खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: gale ke dhakkan mein jhanjhanahat hone se khansi aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Cough, tingling, trachea, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: A cough triggered by a tingling sensation in the windpipe.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: सांस की मुख्य नली में झनझनाहट होने से खांसी आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: sans ki mukhya nali mein jhanjhanahat hone se khansi aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough that gets worse when the voice box (throat area) is touched lightly.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: गले के ढक्कन को हल्के से छूने पर खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: gale ke dhakkan ko halke se chhune par khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Cough, touching, the canal of ear, on
Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough triggered by touching or putting something in the ear canal.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कान की नली को छूने पर खांसी आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: kaan ki nali ko chhune par khansi aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, turning, from left to right side amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets better when you turn from your left side to your right side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बाईं करवट से दाईं करवट लेने पर खांसी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: bai karavat se dai karavat lene par khansi kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets worse when you turn over in bed.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बिस्तर पर करवट बदलने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: bistar par karavat badlne se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A cough that gets worse when you turn onto your side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: एक तरफ करवट लेने पर खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: ek taraf karavat lene par khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough that gets worse when you turn your head.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: सिर घुमाने पर खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: sir ghumane par khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing gets worse when uncovering the body.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: शरीर का कोई हिस्सा खुला होने पर खांसी और बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: sharir ka koi hissa khula hone par khansi aur badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing triggered by uncovering the feet or head.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पैर या सिर खुले रहने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: pair ya sir khule rehne par khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing triggered by uncovering the hands.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हाथ खुले रहने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Hath khule rahne par khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: A cough that developed after having smallpox.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: चेचक (बड़ी माता) ठीक होने के बाद खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Chechak (badi mata) theek hone ke baad khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: A cough that occurs during a smallpox illness.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: चेचक (बड़ी माता) की बीमारी के दौरान खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Chechak (badi mata) ki bimari ke dauran khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A very forceful, severe cough that occurs in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद खांसी बहुत तेज़ हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad khansi bahut tez ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A very forceful, severe cough that occurs during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय खांसी बहुत तेज़ होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay khansi bahut tez hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A very forceful, severe cough that occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को खांसी बहुत तेज़ हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko khansi bahut tez ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A very forceful, severe cough that comes on in the evening after lying down.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को लेटने के बाद खांसी बहुत तेज़ हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko letne ke baad khansi bahut tez ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A very forceful, severe cough that occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय खांसी बहुत तेज़ होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay khansi bahut tez hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, violent, morning, early, in bed
Linked to time of day.en: A very forceful, severe cough that occurs early in the morning while still in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह जल्दी बिस्तर पर ही खांसी बहुत तेज़ होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah jaldi bistar par hi khansi bahut tez hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A very forceful, severe cough that occurs in the morning before getting up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने से पहले खांसी बहुत तेज़ होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne se pehle khansi bahut tez hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A very forceful, severe cough that comes on when waking up in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलते ही खांसी बहुत तेज़ आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind khulte hi khansi bahut tez aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A very forceful, severe cough that occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खांसी बहुत तेज़ होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Rat ko khansi bahut tez hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A very forceful, severe cough that occurs at 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 3 बजे खांसी बहुत तेज़ होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Rat ko 3 baje khansi bahut tez hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A very forceful, severe cough that occurs around noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर के समय खांसी बहुत तेज़ होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ke samay khansi bahut tez hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A very forceful, severe cough that happens during sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद में खांसी बहुत तेज़ आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Nind me khansi bahut tez aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A very forceful, severe cough that comes on upon waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद से जागने पर खांसी बहुत तेज़ आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Nind se jagne par khansi bahut tez aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: A very forceful, severe cough that comes on after dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात के खाने के बाद खांसी बहुत तेज़ हो जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Rat ke khane ke baad khansi bahut tez ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A very forceful, severe cough triggered by laughing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हँसने पर खांसी बहुत तेज़ हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Hasne par khansi bahut tez ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A very forceful, severe cough triggered by talking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बात करने पर खांसी बहुत तेज़ हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Baat karne par khansi bahut tez ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A very forceful, severe cough triggered by yawning.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: जम्हाई (उबासी) लेने पर खांसी बहुत तेज़ हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Jamhai (ubasi) lene par khansi bahut tez ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Cough, violent, sitting or lying, while, not during motion
Linked to posture/position.en: A very forceful, severe cough that happens while sitting or lying down but not while moving around.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठने या लेटने पर खांसी बहुत तेज़ होती है, चलते समय नहीं।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Baithne ya letne par khansi bahut tez hoti hai, chalte samay nahi.

Sounds & movement.path: Cough, violent, spasmodic perking of head forward and knees upward
Sounds & movement.en: A very forceful cough where the head jerks forward and the knees pull upward with each coughing fit.
Sounds & movement.hi: तेज़ खांसी आने पर सिर आगे की ओर झटके से आता है और घुटने ऊपर की ओर उठ जाते हैं।
Sounds & movement.roman: Tez khansi aane par sir aage ki or jhatke se aata hai aur ghutne upar ki or uth jate hain.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Cough, violent, uninterrupted until relieved by vomiting
Comes with other symptoms.en: A very forceful, unrelenting cough that only stops after vomiting.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: खांसी तब तक बिना रुके चलती रहती है जब तक उल्टी नहीं हो जाती।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Khansi tab tak bina ruke chalti rahti hai jab tak ulti nahi ho jati.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing gets worse when walking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: चलने पर खांसी और बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Chalne par khansi aur badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing gets better when walking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: चलने से खांसी में आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Chalne se khansi me aaram milta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: A cough triggered by walking fast.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: तेज़ चलने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Tez chalne par khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Coughing gets worse after drinking warm fluids.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: गर्म पेय पीने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Garm pey pine se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Coughing gets better after drinking warm fluids.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: गर्म पेय पीने से खांसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Garm pey pine se khansi me aaram milta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Coughing gets worse after eating warm food.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: गर्म खाना खाने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Garm khana khane se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Coughing gets better after eating warm food.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: गर्म खाना खाने से खांसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Garm khana khane se khansi me aaram milta hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough that comes on when the body becomes warm.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: शरीर गर्म होने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Sharir garm hone par khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough that occurs in a warm room.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म कमरे में खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm kamre mein khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, warm, room, entering, from open air
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough triggered by going from fresh outdoor air into a warm room.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: बाहर खुली हवा से गर्म कमरे में आने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Bahar khuli hawa se garm kamre mein aane par khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, warm, room, going from, to cold air, or vice versa, agg.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Coughing gets worse when moving between a warm room and cold air, or the other way around.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म कमरे से ठंडी हवा में या ठंडी हवा से गर्म कमरे में जाने पर खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm kamre se thandi hawa mein ya thandi hawa se garm kamre mein jane par khansi badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough triggered by being near a warm stove.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म चूल्हे के पास जाने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm chulhe ke paas jane par khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Coughing gets better when the belly is warmed up.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: पेट को गर्म सेंक देने से खांसी में आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Pet ko garm senk dene se khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough that comes on when the weather changes.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: मौसम बदलने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Mausam badlne par khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough that comes on in damp weather.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: नम (गीले) मौसम में खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Nam geele mausam mein khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough that comes on in hot weather.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म मौसम में खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm mausam mein khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough that comes on in stormy weather.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: तूफानी मौसम में खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Tufani mausam mein khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough that comes on in warm, wet weather.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म और नम (उमस भरे) मौसम में खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm aur nam umas bhare mausam mein khansi hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs in the afternoon and continues until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद से आधी रात तक काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad se aadhi raat tak kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.path: Cough, whooping, evening, 6 p.m. to 10 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs in the evening between 6 p.m. and 10 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम 6 बजे से रात 10 बजे तक काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam 6 baje se raat 10 baje tak kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs in the evening and continues until midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम से आधी रात तक काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam se aadhi raat tak kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs in the evening and also at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम और रात दोनों समय काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam aur raat donon samay kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs in the late morning (before noon).
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह 9 से 12 बजे के बीच काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah 9 se 12 baje ke beech kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs at 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 2 बजे काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 2 baje kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs at 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 3 बजे काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 3 baje kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs at midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को ठीक आधी रात को काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko theek aadhi raat ko kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के बाद काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke baad kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Linked to time of day.en: A whooping cough that occurs before midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात से पहले काली खांसी जैसे दौरे आते हैं।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat se pehle kali khansi jaise daure aate hain.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough triggered by exposure to cold wind.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडी हवा में खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi hawa mein khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, wind, cold, dry, in the
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough triggered by being in cold, dry wind.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडी और सूखी हवा में खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi aur sukhi hawa mein khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough triggered by being out in cold wind.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडी हवा लगने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi hawa lagne par khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough triggered by an east wind.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: पूरब (पूर्वी) दिशा की हवा में खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Poorab disha ki hawa mein khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough triggered by being out in the wind.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: हवा के संपर्क में आने पर खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Hawa ke sampark mein aane par khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough triggered by a north wind.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: उत्तर दिशा की हवा में खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Uttar disha ki hawa mein khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough triggered by a sea breeze or wind coming off the sea.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: समुद्री हवा में खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Samudri hawa mein khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough triggered by a sharp, biting wind.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: तेज़ (कड़ी) हवा में खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Tez hawa mein khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough triggered by a south wind.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: दक्षिण दिशा की हवा में खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Dakshan disha ki hawa mein khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough triggered by a west wind.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: पश्चिम दिशा की हवा में खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Paschim disha ki hawa mein khansi hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Coughing gets worse after drinking wine.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: शराब पीने से खांसी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Sharab pene se khansi badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Coughing gets better after drinking wine.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: शराब पीने से खांसी में आराम मिलता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Sharab pene se khansi mein aaram milta hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Cough, winter, alternating with sciatica in summer
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A cough that occurs in winter and alternates with sciatic nerve pain (pain running down the leg) in summer.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: सर्दियों में खांसी होती है और गर्मियों में साइटिका (कमर व टांग का दर्द) हो जाता है, दोनों बारी-बारी से आते हैं।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Sardiyon mein khansi hoti hai aur garmiyon mein sciatica (kamar v tang ka dard) ho jata hai, donon bari-bari se ate hain.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: A winter cough that mainly affects older people.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: सर्दियों में बुजुर्गों को खांसी होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Sardiyon mein bujuragon ko khansi hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Yawning and coughing that keep happening one after the other.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बार-बार जम्हाई आती है और साथ-साथ खांसी भी होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Bar-bar jambhai aati hai aur sath-sath khansi bhi hoti hai.
